-- dbo.PV_SALES_TENDER_BY_TRANSACTION source
CREATE view [dbo].[BACKUP_PV_SALES_TENDER_BY_TRANSACTION_RMB_164_20250819]
AS
select 
psm.SALES_MEMO_ID as SALES_MEMO_ID,
psm.POS_MEMO_NO as POS_MEMO_NO,
stuff((SELECT DISTINCT ',' + pt.TENDER_NAME 
		FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp
		left join PM_TENDER pt 
		on psmp.TENDER_ID_FK = pt.TENDER_ID
		WHERE psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK 
		FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'') as TENDERS
FROM PT_SALES_MEMO psm;

CREATE      VIEW [dbo].[PCV_SALES_STORE_CASHIER_SKU_DEMOGRAPHIC_TX_COUNT_VIP] as
SELECT
	psm.company_code AS 'COMPANY_CODE',
	pl.location_code,
	psm.TX_DATE AS 'TX_DATE',
	psm.CASHIER_CODE as 'STAFF_NO',
	psmih.SKU ,
	pn.DEMOGRAPHIC AS 'DEMOGRAPHIC',
	CASE
		WHEN psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT > 0 THEN 'SALE'
		ELSE 'RETURN'
	END AS SALE_OR_RETURN,
		CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' then 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.qty < 0  then 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' then 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS 'IS_REVENUE_ITEM',
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID ,
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT ) as TX_AMOUNT,
	sum(psmih.QTY ) as 'ITEM_COUNT',
	COUNT_BIG(*) AS 'RECORD_COUNT'
FROM
	dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm
INNER JOIN dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih ON
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt ON
	psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
	INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SKU ps ON
	psmih.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE
	AND psmih.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
	INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SKU_ATTR psa ON
	ps.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK = psa.SKU_ATTR_ID
------------------------------------------
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2 ON
	pc2.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_LOCATION pl ON
	psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = pl.LOCATION_ID
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst ON
	pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_VIP pv ON
	psm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO
	AND psm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_CUSTOMER pc ON
	pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_CUSTOMER_SECRET pcs ON
	pc.CUSTOMER_ID = pcs.CUSTOMER_ID_FK
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_NATION pn ON
	pcs.COMPANY_CODE = pn.COMPANY_CODE
	AND pcs.COUNTRY_RESIDENCE = pn.ISO3_CODE
INNER JOIN (select max(prd.REPORT_DATE ) as MAX_DATE from dbo.PR_REPORT_DATES prd) a on 
	psm.REPORT_DT > a.MAX_DATE 
WHERE
	psmt.TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('03',
	'04',
	'05',
	'06',
	'07',
	'09',
	'10',
	'11',
	'99',
	'08')
	AND psm.MEMO_STATUS NOT IN ('VOIDED')
	AND psm.MEMO_KIND NOT IN ('RESERVE',
	'handoff')
--	AND psm.TX_DT < pprs.MV_DT
	AND pst.STORE_TYPE_NAME <> 'ONLINE'
	AND psm.VIP_NO IS NOT NULL
	AND psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT <> 0
	AND psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE <> 0
--	and psm.TX_DT >= '2019-07-11'
--	and psm.TX_DT < '2019-07-12'
--	and psm.COMPANY_CODE = 'HKEL'
GROUP BY
	psm.company_code,
	pl.location_code,
	psm.TX_DATE ,
	pn.DEMOGRAPHIC,
	psm.CASHIER_CODE ,
	psmih.SKU ,
	CASE
		WHEN psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT > 0 THEN 'SALE'
		ELSE 'RETURN'
	END ,
	CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' then 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.qty < 0  then 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' then 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END ,
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID

	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) AS 'SALES_NET_AMT',
	sum(psmih.QTY) AS 'QTY',
	COUNT_BIG(*) AS RECORD_COUNT
	--COUNT(DISTINCT psm.MEMO_NO) as 'MEMO_COUNT'
	FROM dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm

CREATE view [dbo].[PMV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY]
as
SELECT 
pil.COMPANY_CODE ,
pil.LOCATION_ID ,
CAST (pil.MOVEMENT_DT as Date) as MOVEMENT_DT ,
pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE, 
pil.ORDER_TYPE ,
pil.ORDER_NUMBER,
pil.SKU ,
pil.MOVEMENT_QTY ,
Case when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'BT' then 'ADJUSTMENT' 
when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'TR' and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY < 0 then 'TRANSFER_OUT'
when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'TR' and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY >= 0 then 'TRANSFER_IN'
when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'IA' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'AR' then 'ASN'
when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER, LEN(pil.LOCATION_ID)+1, 2) = 'RW' then 'RTW'
when pil.ORDER_TYPE = 'GIFT' then 'SALES'
when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
ELSE pil.ORDER_TYPE 
END as TRANS_TYPE,
--Case when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE in ('SALES', 'ONHAND') then 'ONHAND'
--when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE in ('RETURN', 'RETURN_FROM_CUSTOMER') then 'RETURN'
--when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE in ('GIFT_ISSUE', 'GIFT') then 'GIFT'
--when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE in ('TESTER') then 'TESTER'
--END as BUCKET
pil.BALANCE_TYPE as BUCKET
FROM 
PL_INVENTORY_LOG pil 
where pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE not in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'RESERVE', 'RESERVE_RELEASE')

create     view [dbo].[PMV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_LOG]
--WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS select 
 pc2.company_desc, 
 pst.store_type_name, 
 pl.location_desc, 
 pl.location_code,
 pl.location_name,
 ps.sku_Code,
concat( pi2.item_desc_1,pi2.item_desc_2) item_desc,
 pi2.item_id,
 pb2.brand_desc,
 pb.bu_desc,
 pd.dept_name, 
 pc.class_desc,
 pi2.subclass_id_fk,
  pc.company_code,
  CASE 
  when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' 
    then 'OHAND' 
  when   il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ONHAND' 
      then 
        case
        when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT'
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT'     then 'OHAND'  end  
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE'
        or  (il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RESERVE' and il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' ) then 'RESERVE' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN_FROM_CUSTOMER')
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') then 'RETURN' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'GIFT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE= 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'GIFT' ) then 'GIFT' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'TESTER') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'TESTER' ) then 'TESTER'       
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_IN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'IN_TRANSIT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_OUT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'IN_TRANSIT' ) then 'IN_TRANSIT' 
  else 'NA'
  end as inventory_bucket, 
case 
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' or il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE' then 'SALES' 
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' then 'RECEIVING'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' then 'RTW'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' then 'TRASFET_IN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT' then 'TRASFET_OUT'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        else 'NA' 
 end as movement_Type,
CONVERT(varchar(10), il.movement_dt, 126) as movement_DATE, 
SUM(il.movement_qty) qty,
count_big(*) c
from dbo.PL_INVENTORY_LOG il, dbo.PM_LOCATION pl, dbo.PM_ITEM pi2, dbo.PM_ITEM_ATTR pia, dbo.PM_SKU ps, dbo.pm_sku_attr psa,
 dbo.PM_CLASS pc, dbo.PM_BU pb, dbo.PM_BRAND pb2, dbo.PM_DEPT pd, dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2, dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst, dbo.PR_POS_REPORT_SUP pprs
 where 
    il.LOCATION_ID = pl.LOCATION_CODE
    and il.COMPANY_CODE = pl.COMPANY_CODE
    and il.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
    and il.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE
            and pb.BU_CODE = pi2.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE 
           and pb.COMPANY_CODE  = pi2.COMPANY_CODE  
           and pd.dept_code = pi2.dept_code 
           and pd.company_code =pi2.company_code
           and pc.class_id = pi2.class_id_fk  
           and pb2.brand_id = pi2.brand_id_fk  
           and pi2.ITEM_ATTR_ID_FK = pia.ITEM_ATTR_ID  
           and pi2.item_id = ps.item_id_fk
           and pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
           and pc2.COMPANY_CODE = il.COMPANY_CODE
           and psa.sku_attr_id = ps.sku_attr_id_fk
           and pia.IS_PLASTIC_BAG = 'N'
           and il.MOVEMENT_DT < pprs.MV_DT
group by  CASE 
  when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' 
    then 'OHAND' 
  when   il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ONHAND' 
      then 
        case
        when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT'
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT'     then 'OHAND'  end  
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE'
        or  (il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RESERVE' and il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' ) then 'RESERVE' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN_FROM_CUSTOMER')
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') then 'RETURN' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'GIFT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE= 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'GIFT' ) then 'GIFT' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'TESTER') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'TESTER' ) then 'TESTER'       
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_IN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'IN_TRANSIT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_OUT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'IN_TRANSIT' ) then 'IN_TRANSIT' 
  else 'NA'
  end , 
case 
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' or il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE' then 'SALES' 
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' then 'RECEIVING'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' then 'RTW'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' then 'TRASFET_IN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT' then 'TRASFET_OUT'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        else 'NA' 
 end ,
 CONVERT(varchar(10), il.movement_dt, 126),
 pc2.company_desc, 
 pst.store_type_name, 
 pl.location_desc, 
 pl.location_code,
 pl.location_name,
 ps.sku_Code,
concat( pi2.item_desc_1,pi2.item_desc_2) ,
 pi2.item_id,
 pb2.brand_desc,
 pb.bu_desc,
 pd.dept_name, 
  pc.company_code,
 pc.class_desc,

COUNT(DISTINCT psm.MEMO_NO) as 'MEMO_COUNT'

and psm.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')

pi2.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE,

CREATE VIEW [DBO].[PMV_SALES_DETAIL_STORE_TENDER]
--WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT
	PSM.TX_DATE AS TX_DATE,
	CAST(CAST(PSM.TX_DT AS TIME) AS VARCHAR(8)) AS TX_TIME,
	PC2.COMPANY_CODE AS COMPANY_CODE,
	PC2.COMPANY_DESC AS COMPANY_DESC,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS STORE_TYPE_CODE,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS STORE_TYPE_NAME,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC,
	PL.CITY_TXT AS STORE_LOCATION,
	PL.LOCATION_CODE AS STORE_ID,
	PL.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCATION_CODE,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC AS STORE_NAME,
	PSM.MEMO_NO AS TRANSACTION_ID,
	PSM.TX_DT AS TRANSACTION_TIME,
	PT2.TENDER_CODE AS TENDER_CODE,
	CASE
		WHEN PT2.TENDER_NAME = 'CASH' THEN PT2.TENDER_NAME + ' - ' + PC.CCY_CODE
		ELSE PT2.TENDER_NAME
	END AS TENDER_NAME,
	SUM(PSMP.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT,
	PSM.POS_MEMO_NO AS POS_TRANSACTION_ID,
	CASE
		WHEN RIGHT(PL.COUNTRY_ID_FK,
		3)= 'MAC' THEN 'MO'
		WHEN RIGHT(PL.COUNTRY_ID_FK,
		3)= 'HKG' THEN 'HK'
		ELSE LEFT(PL.COMPANY_CODE,
		2)
	END AS ENTITY,
	PSM.CASHIER_CODE AS EMPLOYEE_ID,
	PU.NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME,
	POMBT.ORIG_MEMO_NO AS ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_ID
FROM
	DBO.PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT PSMP
INNER JOIN DBO.PT_SALES_MEMO PSM
ON
	PSMP.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = PSM.SALES_MEMO_ID
INNER JOIN DBO.PM_COMPANY PC2
ON
	PC2.COMPANY_CODE = PSMP.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN DBO.PM_TERMINAL PT
ON
	PSM.TERMINAL_ID_FK = PT.TERMINAL_ID
INNER JOIN DBO.PM_LOCATION PL
ON
	PT.LOCATION_ID_FK = PL.LOCATION_ID
INNER JOIN DBO.PM_STORE_TYPE PST
ON
	PL.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = PST.STORE_TYPE_ID
LEFT JOIN DBO.PM_TENDER PT2
ON
	PSMP.TENDER_ID_FK = PT2.TENDER_ID
LEFT JOIN DBO.PM_CURRENCY PC
ON
	PT2.CURRENCY_ID_FK = PC.CURRENCY_ID
LEFT JOIN PM_USER PU ON
	PU.COMPANY_CODE = PSM.COMPANY_CODE
	AND PU.USER_CODE = PSM.CASHIER_CODE
INNER JOIN DBO.PR_POS_REPORT_SUP PPRS
ON
	1 = 1
LEFT JOIN PV_ORIG_MEMO_BY_TRANSACTION POMBT ON
	POMBT.SALES_MEMO_ID = PSM.SALES_MEMO_ID 
	AND POMBT.ORIG_MEMO_NO IS NOT NULL
WHERE
	PSM.TX_DT < PPRS.MV_DT 
GROUP BY
	PSM.TX_DATE ,
	CAST(CAST(PSM.TX_DT AS TIME) AS VARCHAR(8)) ,
	PC2.COMPANY_CODE ,
	PC2.COMPANY_DESC ,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_CODE ,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_NAME ,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC,
	PL.CITY_TXT ,
	PL.LOCATION_CODE ,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC ,
	PSM.MEMO_NO,
	PSM.TX_DT,
	PT2.TENDER_CODE,
	CASE
		WHEN RIGHT(PL.COUNTRY_ID_FK,
		3)= 'MAC' THEN 'MO'
		WHEN RIGHT(PL.COUNTRY_ID_FK,
		3)= 'HKG' THEN 'HK'
		ELSE LEFT(PL.COMPANY_CODE,
		2)
	END ,
	--PT2.TENDER_NAME,
CASE
		WHEN PT2.TENDER_NAME = 'CASH' THEN PT2.TENDER_NAME + ' - ' + PC.CCY_CODE
		ELSE PT2.TENDER_NAME
	END,
	PSM.POS_MEMO_NO,
	PSM.CASHIER_CODE ,
	PU.NAME,
	POMBT.ORIG_MEMO_NO

inner join PT_SALES_DISCOUNT_D psdd

and psdh.DISC_TYPE  = ppd.LAYER

left join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF psmis

left join dbo.PM_STAFF ps2

CREATE   view [dbo].[PMV_SETTLEMENT_TERMINAL_TENDER]

as
select 
--pcs2.CASH_SETTLEMENT_ID,
t.TX_DATE as TX_DATE,

pc2.COMPANY_DESC as COMPANY_DESC,

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_ACTUAL_SELL_THROUGH_RAW_DATA_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY] AS

	timbd.LOCATION_CODE,

	timbd.MOVEMENT_DATE ,

	sum(timbd.MOVEMENT_QTY) as MOVEMENT_QTY
	from 
		PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 timbd
	inner join 
		(
			select
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU, max(a.OPEN_BALANCE_DT) MAX_BALANCE_DT
			from
				PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 a

				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU 
		) inv
	on timbd.COMPANY_CODE = inv.COMPANY_CODE

CREATE   view [dbo].[PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_LOG]
--WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS select 
 pc2.company_desc, 
 pst.store_type_name, 
 pl.location_desc, 
 pl.location_code,
 pl.location_name,
 ps.sku_Code,
concat( pi2.item_desc_1,pi2.item_desc_2) item_desc,
 pi2.item_id,
 pb2.brand_desc,
 pb.bu_desc,
 pd.dept_name, 
 psub.subclass_desc,
 pc.class_desc,
 pc.company_code,
  CASE 
  when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' 
    then 'OHAND' 
  when   il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ONHAND' 
      then 
        case
        when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT'
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT'     then 'OHAND'  end  
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE'
        or  (il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RESERVE' and il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' ) then 'RESERVE' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN_FROM_CUSTOMER')
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') then 'RETURN' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'GIFT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE= 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'GIFT' ) then 'GIFT' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'TESTER') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'TESTER' ) then 'TESTER'       
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_IN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'IN_TRANSIT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_OUT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'IN_TRANSIT' ) then 'IN_TRANSIT' 
  else 'NA'
  end as inventory_bucket, 
case 
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' or il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE' then 'SALES' 
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' then 'RECEIVING'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' then 'RTW'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' then 'TRASFET_IN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT' then 'TRASFET_OUT'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        else 'NA' 
 end as movement_Type,
CONVERT(varchar(10), il.movement_dt, 126) as movement_DATE, 
SUM(il.movement_qty) qty,
count_big(*) c
from dbo.PL_INVENTORY_LOG il, dbo.PM_LOCATION pl, dbo.PM_ITEM pi2
left join dbo.PM_SUBCLASS psub on psub.subclass_id = pi2.subclass_id_fk
, dbo.PM_ITEM_ATTR pia, dbo.PM_SKU ps, dbo.pm_sku_attr psa,
 dbo.PM_CLASS pc, dbo.PM_BU pb, dbo.PM_BRAND pb2, dbo.PM_DEPT pd, dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2, dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst, dbo.PR_POS_REPORT_SUP pprs
 where 
    il.LOCATION_ID = pl.LOCATION_CODE
    and il.COMPANY_CODE = pl.COMPANY_CODE
    and il.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
    and il.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE
            and pb.BU_CODE = pi2.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE 
           and pb.COMPANY_CODE  = pi2.COMPANY_CODE  
           and pd.dept_code = pi2.dept_code 
           and pd.company_code =pi2.company_code
           and pc.class_id = pi2.class_id_fk  
           and pb2.brand_id = pi2.brand_id_fk  
           and pi2.ITEM_ATTR_ID_FK = pia.ITEM_ATTR_ID  
           and pi2.item_id = ps.item_id_fk
           and pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
           and pc2.COMPANY_CODE = il.COMPANY_CODE
           and psa.sku_attr_id = ps.sku_attr_id_fk
           and pia.IS_PLASTIC_BAG = 'N'
           and il.MOVEMENT_DT > pprs.MV_DT
group by  CASE 
  when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' 
    then 'OHAND' 
  when   il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ONHAND' 
      then 
        case
        when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' 
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT'
        or  il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT'     then 'OHAND'  end  
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE'
        or  (il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RESERVE' and il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' ) then 'RESERVE' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN_FROM_CUSTOMER')
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN') then 'RETURN' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'GIFT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE= 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'GIFT' ) then 'GIFT' 
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'TESTER') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'TESTER' ) then 'TESTER'       
    when (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_IN' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'IN_TRANSIT') 
        or (il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSFER_OUT' and il.MOVEMENT_TYPE  = 'IN_TRANSIT' ) then 'IN_TRANSIT' 
  else 'NA'
  end , 
case 
    when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'SALES' or il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RESERVE' then 'SALES' 
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ASN_RECEIVE' then 'RECEIVING'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RTW' then 'RTW'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_IN' then 'TRASFET_IN'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'TRANSTER_OUT' then 'TRASFET_OUT'
      when il.ORDER_TYPE = 'ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        else 'NA' 
 end ,
 CONVERT(varchar(10), il.movement_dt, 126),
 pc2.company_desc, 
 pst.store_type_name, 
 pl.location_desc, 
 pl.location_code,
 pl.location_name,
 ps.sku_Code,
concat( pi2.item_desc_1,pi2.item_desc_2) ,
 pi2.item_id,
 pb2.brand_desc,
 pb.bu_desc,
 pd.dept_name, 
 psub.subclass_desc,
  pc.company_code,
 pc.class_desc
 union 
(
 select piml.company_desc, piml.store_type_name, piml.location_desc, piml.location_code, piml.location_name, 
 piml.sku_Code, piml.item_desc, piml.item_id, piml.brand_desc, piml.bu_desc, piml.dept_name, piml.class_desc, piml.company_code, 
 piml.inventory_bucket, piml.movement_Type, piml.movement_DATE, piml.qty, psub.subclass_desc , piml.c from dbo.PMV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_LOG piml left join dbo.PM_SUBCLASS psub on psub.subclass_id = piml.subclass_id_fk
 )

CREATE   VIEW [PV_R0002] AS
SELECT
	psm.company_code as 'COMPANY_CODE',
	pc2.COMPANY_DESC as 'COMPANY_DESC',
	pl.location_code,
	pl.LOCATION_DESC,
	CONCAT( pl.ADDRESS1,
pl.ADDRESS2,
pl.ADDRESS3) as 'Address',
	pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE as STORE_TYPE_NAME,
	psm.TX_DATE as 'TX_DATE',
	CASE		
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04', '05') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.COMPANY_CODE IN ('AUCS', 'NZCS')
		and psa.IH_L1 = '120' THEN 'Y'
		-- To include CS STORE Saleable Sample
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' then 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y'
		and psmih.qty < 0 then 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' then 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS 'IS_REVENUE_ITEM',
	sum(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * qty) as 'SALES_GROSS_AMT',
	sum(psmih.GROSS_LINE_AMT_EXCLUDE_TAX) as 'SALES_GROSS_AMT_EXCL_TAX',
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) as 'SALES_AMT',
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT_EXCLUDE_TAX) as 'SALES_AMT_EXCL_TAX',
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT - psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * qty) as 'MARK_DOWNN',
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT_EXCLUDE_TAX - psmih.GROSS_LINE_AMT_EXCLUDE_TAX) as 'MARK_DOWN_EXCL_TAX',
	sum(psmih.QTY) as 'QTY',
	COUNT(DISTINCT psm.MEMO_NO) as 'MEMO_COUNT',
	CASE
		WHEN psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT >= 0 then 'SALE'
		When psmih.QTY > 0 then 'SALE'
		when psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04', '05') THEN 'SALE'
		When psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' then 'SALE'
		else 'RETURN'
	end as 'SALE_OR_RETURN',
	pt.TERMINAL_NO,
	sum( CASE when abs(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) <> abs(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.qty) THEN psmih.qty ELSE 0 END ) as DISCOUNTED_QTY,
	--COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE when psa.IH_L1 = '110' and psmih.NET_LINE_AMT - psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE <> 0 and psmih.QTY > 0 then psm.MEMO_NO WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' and psmih.NET_LINE_AMT - psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE <> 0 and psmih.QTY > 0 then psm.MEMO_NO end ) )as DISCOUNTED_MEMO_COUNT
	COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE when abs(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) <> abs(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.qty) then psm.MEMO_NO end ) )as DISCOUNTED_MEMO_COUNT,
	SUM(psmih.LINE_TAX1_AMT) as TAX_AMT
From
	dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm
inner join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih
on
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
inner join dbo.PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt
on
	psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
inner join dbo.PM_SKU ps
on
	ps.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
	and psmih.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
inner join dbo.PM_SKU_ATTR psa
on
	ps.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK = psa.SKU_ATTR_ID
	-----
inner join dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2
on
	pc2.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
inner join dbo.PM_LOCATION pl
on
	psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = pl.LOCATION_ID
inner join dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst
on
	pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID
inner join PM_TERMINAL pt
on
	psm.TERMINAL_ID_FK = pt.TERMINAL_ID
where
	psmt.TYPE_CODE not in ('06', '07', '09', '10', '11', '99', '08')
	and psm.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')
	and psm.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE', 'handoff')
	and psmih.NET_LINE_AMT <> 0
	--and psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = 'HKCMHKCM0016'
	--and psm.TX_DT >= '2020-12-30'
	--and psm.TX_DT < '2020-12-31'
GROUP BY
	psm.company_code,
	pc2.COMPANY_DESC,
	pl.LOCATION_DESC,
	pl.ADDRESS1,
	pl.ADDRESS2,

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R0002_NON_REV_SUB] AS 
SELECT

	pl.location_code,
	psm.TX_DATE as 'TX_DATE',
	psmt.TYPE_CODE ,
	pgcc.GIFT_CARD_TYPE ,
	CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '03' THEN 'Deposit'
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '04' THEN 'Deposit Refund'
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '05' THEN pgcc.GIFT_CARD_TYPE + ' Issue'
		WHEN pia.IS_PLASTIC_BAG = 'Y' THEN 'Shopping Bag'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' THEN 'Service Package'
		ELSE 'Others'
	END as NON_REVENUE_PRODUCT_TYPE,
	sum(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * qty) as 'SALES_GROSS_AMT',
	sum(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) as 'SALES_NET_AMT',
	sum(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * qty - psmih.NET_LINE_AMT) as MARKDOWN,
	sum(psmih.QTY) as 'QTY',
	COUNT(DISTINCT psm.MEMO_NO) as 'MEMO_COUNT',
	pt.TERMINAL_NO,
	CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04', '05') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.COMPANY_CODE IN ('AUCS', 'NZCS')
		AND psa.IH_L1 = '120' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.qty < 0 THEN 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS 'IS_REVENUE_ITEM'
	----------------
	--------------
FROM
	dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm
	--------------------------------
INNER JOIN dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih on
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
	--------------------------------
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt on
	psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
	----------------------------------------
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SKU ps on
	psmih.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE
	AND psmih.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SKU_ATTR psa
	-------------------------------------------
 on
	ps.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK = psa.SKU_ATTR_ID
	-----
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_ITEM pi2 on
	ps.ITEM_ID_FK = pi2.ITEM_ID
INNER JOIN PM_ITEM_ATTR pia on
	pia.ITEM_ATTR_ID = pi2.ITEM_ATTR_ID_FK
	-----------------------------------------
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2 on
	pc2.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_LOCATION pl on
	psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = pl.LOCATION_ID
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst on
	pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID
INNER JOIN PM_TERMINAL pt on
	psm.TERMINAL_ID_FK = pt.TERMINAL_ID
LEFT JOIN PC_GIFT_CARD_CFG pgcc on
	pgcc.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
	AND pgcc.SKU_CODE = psmih.SKU
INNER JOIN dbo.PR_POS_REPORT_SUP pprs on
	1 = 1
WHERE
	psmt.TYPE_CODE not in (
	--'05',
	'06',
	'07',
	'09',
	'10',
	'11',
	'99',
	'08')
	AND psm.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')
	AND psm.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE', 'hANDoff')
	--AND psm.MEMO_STATUS= 'COMPLETED'
	AND ( 
			pia.IS_PLASTIC_BAG = 'Y'
		OR psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04', '05')
			OR (( psa.IH_L1 = '110'
				AND psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y')
			OR (psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'N'
				AND psa.IH_L1 <> '110'))
		)
	AND psmih.NET_LINE_AMT <> 0
	AND pst.STORE_TYPE_NAME <> 'ONLINE'
GROUP BY
	psm.company_code,
	pl.location_code,
	pt.TERMINAL_NO,
	psm.TX_DATE ,
	psmt.TYPE_CODE ,
	pgcc.GIFT_CARD_TYPE,
	CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '03' THEN 'Deposit'
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '04' THEN 'Deposit Refund'
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '05' THEN pgcc.GIFT_CARD_TYPE + ' Issue'
		WHEN pia.IS_PLASTIC_BAG = 'Y' THEN 'Shopping Bag'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' THEN 'Service Package'
		ELSE 'Others'
	END,
	CASE
		WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE in ('03', '04', '05') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.COMPANY_CODE IN ('AUCS', 'NZCS')
		AND psa.IH_L1 = '120' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y'
		AND psmih.qty < 0 THEN 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' THEN 'Y'

CREATE   view [dbo].[PV_R0018] as 
select 
pr.*,
	d.BALANCE + sum(d.MVMT_QTY) as CLOSING_QUANTITY,
	(d.BALANCE + sum(d.MVMT_QTY)) * isnull(pr.SUGGESTED_RETAIL_PRICE , 0) as CLOSING_$_VALUE,
	d.BALANCE + sum(d.MVMT_QTY) - pr.SALES_QTY - pr.TRANSFER_OUT_QTY - pr.TRANSFER_IN_QTY - pr.RTW_QUANTITY - pr.RECEIVE_QTY - pr.ADJUSTMENT_QUANTITY - pr.RTW_QTY as OPENING_QUANTITY,
	(d.BALANCE + sum(d.MVMT_QTY) - pr.SALES_QTY - pr.TRANSFER_OUT_QTY - pr.TRANSFER_IN_QTY - pr.RTW_QUANTITY - pr.RECEIVE_QTY - pr.ADJUSTMENT_QUANTITY - pr.RTW_QTY) * isnull(pr.SUGGESTED_RETAIL_PRICE , 0) as OPENING_$_VALUE
	from PV_R0018_NOINV pr
left join
(
select
	timbd.COMPANY_CODE ,
	timbd.LOCATION_CODE,
	timbd.BALANCE_TYPE as BUCKET_TYPE,
	timbd.SKU as SKU_10,
	timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
	timbd.MOVEMENT_DATE ,
	timbd.BALANCE,
	sum(timbd.MOVEMENT_QTY) as MVMT_QTY
	from 
		PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 timbd
	inner join 
		(
			select
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU, max(a.OPEN_BALANCE_DT) MAX_BALANCE_DT
			from
				PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 a
			where a.OPEN_BALANCE_DT <= getdate() 
			group by
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU 
		) inv
	on timbd.COMPANY_CODE = inv.COMPANY_CODE 
	and timbd.LOCATION_CODE = inv.LOCATION_CODE
	and timbd.BALANCE_TYPE = inv.BALANCE_TYPE
	and timbd.SKU = inv.SKU
	and timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT = inv.MAX_BALANCE_DT
	where 1 =1 
	--and timbd.LOCATION_CODE = @location 
	group by
		timbd.COMPANY_CODE ,
		timbd.LOCATION_CODE,
		timbd.BALANCE_TYPE ,
		timbd.SKU,
		timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
		timbd.BALANCE,timbd.MOVEMENT_DATE 
) d 
on pr.COMPANY_CODE = d.COMPANY_CODE
and pr.LOCATION_ID	= d.LOCATION_CODE
and pr.SKU_10= d.SKU_10
and pr.INVENTORY_BUCKET= d.BUCKET_TYPE
and d.MOVEMENT_DATE<=CAST(pr.TX_DT as DATE)
--where  pr.TX_DT=>'2021-05-01' and pr.TX_DT<='2021-05-31'
--and pr.location_id='HKMC0011' and pr.sku_10='M0N9040000'
group by pr.COMPANY_CODE ,
pr.STORE_TYPE,
pr.STORE_LOCATION,
pr.LOCATION_ID ,
pr.STORE_NAME,
pr.SKU_10,
pr.SKU_6,
pr.SKU_4,
pr.PRODUCT_NAME,
pr.UPC,
pr.SUB_BRAND,
pr.MAJOR_CATEGORY,
pr.MAJOR_CATEGORY_CODE,
pr.APPLICATION,
pr.APPLICATION_CODE,
pr.CATEGORY,
pr.CATEGORY_CODE,
pr.SUB_CATEGORY,
pr.SUB_CATEGORY_CODE,
pr.INVENTORY_HIERARCHY,
pr.L1,
pr.L2,
pr.L3,
pr.L4,
pr.L5,
pr.SUGGESTED_RETAIL_PRICE,
pr.TX_DT,
pr.INVENTORY_BUCKET ,
pr.SALES_QTY,
pr.TRANSFER_OUT_QTY,
pr.TRANSFER_IN_QTY,
pr.RTW_QUANTITY,
pr.RECEIVE_QTY,
pr.ADJUSTMENT_QUANTITY,
pr.RTW_QTY,
pr.STATUS,
pr.REASON,
pr.UOM,
d.balance

CREATE   VIEW PV_R0018A AS (
-- modified by rmohamed on 2025-03-07
-- Key change: added 2 Union to current selection
-- 1st part: Target Sales Related from PT_SALES_MEMO
-- 2nd part: Target BOM Related in PL_INVENTORY_LOG
-- 3rd part: Target Non Sales and Non BOM Related
-- PT_SALES_MEMO_SECTION
SELECT 
    LEFT(pil.COMPANY_CODE,2) as AFFILIATE_CODE,
    pil.COMPANY_CODE ,
    pil.LOCATION_ID ,
    pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE,
    pil.ORDER_TYPE ,
    pil.ORDER_NUMBER,
    ppcs.CHILD_SKU as SKU,
    psd.PRODUCT_NAME as SKU_DESC,
    pil.MOVEMENT_QTY,
    psd.RETAIL_PRICE ,
    COALESCE (pu.NAME, pil.CRE_BY) as CRE_BY,
    pil.MOVEMENT_DT,
    Case
        when pil.ORDER_TYPE = 'GIFT' then 'SALES'
        when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
        ELSE pil.ORDER_TYPE
    END as TRANS_TYPE,
    pil.BALANCE_TYPE as BUCKET,
    psa.DEFAULT_UOM_CODE as UOM,
    pil.ORDER_NUMBER as MEMO_NO,
    ppcs.PARENT_SKU as PARENT_SKU,
    ppcs.PARENT_PRODUCT_NAME as PRODUCT_NAME
FROM PT_SALES_MEMO psm 
LEFT JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih on 
	psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
LEFT JOIN PV_PARENT_CHILD_SKU ppcs on 
	ppcs.PARENT_SKU = psmih.SKU 
	AND ppcs.COMPANY_CODE = psmih.COMPANY_CODE
LEFT JOIN PL_INVENTORY_LOG pil on 
	psm.MEMO_NO = pil.ORDER_NUMBER 
	and pil.SKU = ppcs.CHILD_SKU 
	and psmih.SKU = ppcs.PARENT_SKU
left join PV_SKU_DETAIL psd on
	psd.COMPANY_CODE = ppcs.COMPANY_CODE
	and psd.SKU_10 = ppcs.CHILD_SKU 
left join PM_USER pu on
	pu.COMPANY_CODE = pil.COMPANY_CODE
	and pu.NAME = pil.CRE_BY
LEFT join PM_SKU ps21 on
	pil.COMPANY_CODE = ps21.COMPANY_CODE
	and pil.SKU = ps21.SKU_CODE
LEFT join PM_SKU_ATTR psa on
	pil.COMPANY_CODE = psa.COMPANY_CODE
	and psa.SKU_ATTR_ID = ps21.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK
where
	pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE not in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'RESERVE', 'RESERVE_RELEASE')
GROUP BY 
LEFT(pil.COMPANY_CODE,2),
pil.LOG_NO,
pil.COMPANY_CODE ,
pil.LOCATION_ID ,
pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE,
pil.ORDER_TYPE ,
pil.ORDER_NUMBER,
ppcs.CHILD_SKU,
psd.PRODUCT_NAME,
pil.MOVEMENT_QTY,
psd.RETAIL_PRICE,
COALESCE (pu.NAME, pil.CRE_BY),
pil.MOVEMENT_DT,
pil.BALANCE_TYPE,
psa.DEFAULT_UOM_CODE,
ppcs.PARENT_SKU,
ppcs.PARENT_PRODUCT_NAME
-- PL_INVENTORY_LOG FOR BOM SECTION
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    LEFT(pil.COMPANY_CODE,
    2) as AFFILIATE_CODE,
    pil.COMPANY_CODE ,
    pil.LOCATION_ID ,
    pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE,
    pil.ORDER_TYPE ,
    pil.ORDER_NUMBER,
    isNULL(pbid.SKU_CODE, pil.SKU) as SKU ,
    psd.PRODUCT_NAME as SKU_DESC,
    CASE WHEN pbid.SKU_CODE is NULL then pil.MOVEMENT_QTY 
        ELSE pbid.QTY * pil.MOVEMENT_QTY 
    END AS MOVEMENT_QTY,
    psd.RETAIL_PRICE ,
    COALESCE (pu.NAME,
    pil.CRE_BY) as CRE_BY,
    pil.MOVEMENT_DT,
    /*For HKTW. All of their location code is 8 in length. So this logic can persists.*/
    --/*
    Case
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'BT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'TR'
        and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY < 0 then 'TRANSFER_OUT'
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'TR'
        and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY >= 0 then 'TRANSFER_IN'
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'IA' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'AR' then 'ASN'
        when substring(pil.ORDER_NUMBER , 9, 2) = 'RW' then 'RTW'
        when pil.ORDER_TYPE = 'GIFT' then 'SALES'
        when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
        ELSE pil.ORDER_TYPE
    END as TRANS_TYPE,
    --*/
    /*
    * For others. Location code length varied. Hence, checking if the flag exists only.
    * Also note that if at any point we have <companycode>AR as order number, please refactor this section.
    */
    /*
    Case
        when CHARINDEX('BT', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0 then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        when CHARINDEX('TR', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0
        and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY < 0 then 'TRANSFER_OUT'
        when CHARINDEX('TR', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0
        and pil.MOVEMENT_QTY >= 0 then 'TRANSFER_IN'
        when CHARINDEX('IA', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0 then 'ADJUSTMENT'
        when CHARINDEX('AR', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0 then 'ASN'
        when CHARINDEX('RW', pil.ORDER_NUMBER) > 0 then 'RTW'
        when pil.ORDER_TYPE = 'GIFT' then 'SALES'
        when pil.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'RETURN' then 'RETURN'
        ELSE pil.ORDER_TYPE
    END as TRANS_TYPE,
    --*/
    pil.BALANCE_TYPE as BUCKET,
    psa.DEFAULT_UOM_CODE as UOM,
    pil.ORDER_NUMBER as MEMO_NO,
    isNULL(pbih.SKU_CODE, pil.SKU) as PARENT_SKU,
    parentSku.SKU_DESC as PRODUCT_NAME
FROM PL_INVENTORY_LOG pil
LEFT JOIN PM_BOM_ITEM_H pbih on pbih.SKU_CODE = pil.SKU AND pil.COMPANY_CODE = pbih.COMPANY_CODE 
LEFT JOIN PM_BOM_ITEM_D pbid on pbih.BOM_ITEM_H_ID = pbid.BOM_ITEM_H_ID_FK 
left join PV_SKU_DETAIL psd on
	psd.COMPANY_CODE = pil.COMPANY_CODE
	and psd.SKU_10 = pbid.SKU_CODE 
LEFT JOIN PV_SKU_DETAIL psdParent on
	psd.COMPANY_CODE = pil.COMPANY_CODE
	and psd.SKU_10 = pil.SKU
left join PM_USER pu on
	pu.COMPANY_CODE = pil.COMPANY_CODE
	and pu.NAME = pil.CRE_BY
LEFT JOIN PM_SKU parentSKU on parentSKU.sku_code = pbih.SKU_CODE and pbih.COMPANY_CODE = parentSku.company_code
LEFT join PM_SKU ps21 on
	pil.COMPANY_CODE = ps21.COMPANY_CODE
	and pbid.SKU_CODE = ps21.SKU_CODE
LEFT join PM_SKU_ATTR psa on
	pil.COMPANY_CODE = psa.COMPANY_CODE
	and psa.SKU_ATTR_ID = ps21.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK
where

CREATE   view [dbo].[PV_R0020] as
SELECT 
iiah.ADJUSTMENT_NO ,
iiah.COMPANY_CODE,
pc.COMPANY_DESC ,
pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE as STORE_TYPE_NAME,
pl.CITY_TXT as STORE_LOCATION,
pl.LOCATION_CODE ,
pl.LOCATION_NAME ,
iiah.CRE_BY ,
ps.FIRST_NAME ,
CAST(idafh.CRE_DATET as DATE) as REQUEST_DATE,
CASE WHEN iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('APPROVED') then CAST(iiah.OVERALL_APPROVE_DT as DATE) 
WHEN iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('REJECTED') then CAST(iiah.OVERALL_APPROVE_DT as DATE) end as COMPLETED_DATE,
CASE WHEN iiah.OVERALL_APPROVED_BY IN ('TRAN_VAR_AUTO_APPROVE') then 'Auto Generated'
else iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS END  as STATUS,
--iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS as STATUS,
iiad.SKU_CODE as SKU_10,
LEFT(iiad.SKU_CODE, 6) as SKU_6,
LEFT(iiad.SKU_CODE, 4) as SKU_4,
--pi2.ITEM_DESC_1 as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
isnull(ps2.SKU_DESC, pi2.ITEM_DESC_1 ) as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
iiah.ADJ_BALANCE as INVENTORY_BUCKET,
--ir.REASON_DESCRIPTION as REASON_CODE,
iiah.reason_code+':'+iiah.reason_desc as REASON_CODE,
isnull(iiad.ORI_RETAIL_PRICE,0) as SUGGESTED_RETAIL_PRICE,
CASE 
	when iiah.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ADD' then iiad.QTY 
	else iiad.QTY * -1
	end as ADJ_QTY,
isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0) as UPDATED_INVENTORY,	 
Case 
	When iiah.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ADD' and iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED'  then isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0)- iiad.QTY 
	when iiah.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'DEDUCT' and iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS  = 'APPROVED' then isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0) + iiad.QTY 
	ELSE isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0)
	end as PRIOR_INVENTORY,
isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0)* iiad.ORI_RETAIL_PRICE as UPDATED_VALUE,
Case 
	When iiah.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'ADD' and iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED'  then (isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0)- iiad.QTY) * iiad.ORI_RETAIL_PRICE
	when iiah.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'DEDUCT' and iiah.OVERALL_APPROVAL_STATUS  = 'APPROVED' then (isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0) + iiad.QTY) * iiad.ORI_RETAIL_PRICE
	ELSE isnull(sb.AS_OF_QTY,0)*iiad.ORI_RETAIL_PRICE 
	end as PRIOR_VALUE,
iiah.REF_STOCKTAKE_NO,
CASE WHEN RIGHT(pl.COUNTRY_ID_FK,3)='MAC' THEN 'MO'
WHEN RIGHT(pl.COUNTRY_ID_FK,3)='HKG' THEN 'HK'
ELSE LEFT(pl.COMPANY_CODE,2) END as ENTITY,
psa.DEFAULT_UOM_CODE as UOM
from IT_INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT_H iiah 
inner join IT_INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT_D iiad 
on iiah.INVENTORY_ADJ_H_ID = iiad.INVENTORY_ADJ_H_ID_FK 
inner join PM_COMPANY pc 
on iiah.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE 
inner join PM_LOCATION pl 
on pl.COMPANY_CODE = iiah.COMPANY_CODE 
and iiah.ADJUST_LOCATION_CODE = pl.LOCATION_CODE 
inner join PM_STORE_TYPE pst 
on pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID 
inner join PM_SKU ps2 
on iiad.COMPANY_CODE = ps2.COMPANY_CODE 
and iiad.SKU_CODE = ps2.SKU_CODE 
inner join PM_SKU_ATTR psa  
on iiad.COMPANY_CODE = psa.COMPANY_CODE 
and psa.SKU_ATTR_ID  = ps2.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK 
inner join PM_ITEM pi2 
on ps2.ITEM_ID_FK = pi2.ITEM_ID 
/*left join IM_REASON ir
on iiah.COMPANY_CODE = ir.COMPANY_CODE 
and iiah.REASON_CODE = ir.POS_REASON_CODE */
left join IT_DOC_APPROVAL_FLOW_H idafh 
on idafh.COMPANY_CODE = iiah.COMPANY_CODE 
and idafh.DOC_ID = iiah.ADJUSTMENT_NO 
and idafh.DOC_TYPE = 'INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT'
left join PM_USER pu 
on pu.COMPANY_CODE = iiah.COMPANY_CODE 
and pu.USER_CODE = iiah.CRE_BY 
left join PM_STAFF ps 
on pu.STAFF_ID_FK = ps.STAFF_ID 
left join (
	select
	timbd.COMPANY_CODE ,
	timbd.LOCATION_CODE,
	timbd.BALANCE_TYPE ,
	timbd.SKU,
	timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
	timbd.BALANCE + sum(timbd.MOVEMENT_QTY) AS_OF_QTY
	from 
		PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 timbd
	inner join 
		(
			select
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU, max(a.OPEN_BALANCE_DT) MAX_BALANCE_DT
			from
				PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 a
			group by
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU 
		) inv
	on timbd.COMPANY_CODE = inv.COMPANY_CODE 
	and timbd.LOCATION_CODE = inv.LOCATION_CODE
	and timbd.BALANCE_TYPE = inv.BALANCE_TYPE
	and timbd.SKU = inv.SKU
	and timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT = inv.MAX_BALANCE_DT
	where 1 =1 
	group by
		timbd.COMPANY_CODE ,
		timbd.LOCATION_CODE,
		timbd.BALANCE_TYPE ,
		timbd.SKU,
		timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
		timbd.BALANCE 
) as sb
on ps2.COMPANY_CODE = sb.COMPANY_CODE
and iiah.ADJUST_LOCATION_CODE = sb.LOCATION_CODE
and iiah.ADJ_BALANCE = sb.BALANCE_TYPE
and ps2.SKU_CODE = sb.sku;

--pcs.TEL1,

--pcs.TEL2 ,

pcs.EMAIL ,
lastStore.LOCATION_ID as PURCHASE_STORE_ID,
lastStore.LOCATION_NAME as PURCHASE_STORE_NAME,
pcs.BIRTH_M ,
pcs.BIRTH_D ,
pv.APPLY_LOCATION as CREATION_STORE_ID,
plapply.LOCATION_NAME as CREATION_STORE_NAME,
pv.JOIN_DT as CREATION_DATE,
--pc.PREF_LOC_CODE as FIRST_PURCHASE_STORE_ID,

plfirst.LOCATION_NAME as FIRST_PURCHASE_STORE_NAME,

lastStore.LOCATION_NAME as LAST_PURCHASE_STORE_NAME,
lastStore.TX_DATE as LAST_PURCHASE_DATE,
lastStore.LOCATION_ID as MOST_FREQUENT_STORE_ID,
lastStore.LOCATION_NAME as MOST_FREQUENT_STORE_NAME,
pvlr.POINT_MOVEMENT as LAST_LOYALTY_REDEMPTION ,
pvls.LIFETIME_SPEND as LIFETIME_SPEND,
pvls.LIFETIME_TX_COUNT as LIFETIME_TRANSACTION,
psm3.TOTAL_NET_AMT as SPEND_WITHIN_RANGE,
CASE when pvpbt.POINTS > 0 then pvpbt.POINTS else 0 end as LOYALTY_POINT_GAINED_WITHIN_RANGE,
CASE when pvpbt.POINTS < 0 then pvpbt.POINTS else 0 end as LOYALTY_POINTS_REDEEMED_WITHIN_RANGE,
1 as TRANSACTION_WITHIN_RANGE,
pvys.LIFETIME_SPEND as FY_YTD_SPEND,
pvys.LIFETIME_TX_COUNT as FY_YTD_TRANS,
pvps.LIFETIME_SPEND as ROLLING_12_SPEND,
pvps.LIFETIME_TX_COUNT as ROLLING_12_TRANS,
pv.EXPIRY_DT as LOYALTY_EXPIRE_DATE,
pvpb.POINTS as CURRENT_LOYALTY_POINTS,
pvpr.REDEEM_POINTS as REDEEMED_POINTS,
PC.ALLOW_SMS as OPT_IN_SMS,
pc.ALLOW_CALL as OPT_IN_PHONE,
pc.ALLOW_EMAIL as OPT_IN_EMAIL,
pc.ALLOW_MAIL as OPT_IN_DIRECT_MAIL,
pcs.AGE_GRP as AGE_GROUP,
pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE as LOYALTY_TIER,
pn.DESCRIPTION as CONSUMER_LOCATION
FROM 
PM_VIP pv 
inner join PM_CUSTOMER pc 
on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID 
inner join PM_CUSTOMER_SECRET pcs 
on pc.CUSTOMER_ID = pcs.CUSTOMER_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PV_VIP_GRADE pvg
on pvg.COMPANY_CODE=pv.COMPANY_CODE AND pvg.VIP_NO= pv.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN dbo.PM_NATION pn 
on pcs.COMPANY_CODE = pn.COMPANY_CODE 
and pcs.COUNTRY_RESIDENCE = pn.ISO3_CODE 
left join PT_SALES_MEMO psm3 
on pv.COMPANY_CODE = psm3.COMPANY_CODE 
and pv.VIP_NO = psm3.VIP_NO 
left join PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt2 
on psm3.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt2.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID 
left join PM_LOCATION plapply
on plapply.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and plapply.LOCATION_CODE = pv.APPLY_LOCATION 
left join PM_LOCATION plfirst
on plfirst.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and plfirst.LOCATION_CODE = COALESCE (pc.PREF_LOC_CODE,pv.APPLY_LOCATION) 
left join PV_VIP_POINT_BY_TRANSACTION pvpbt 
on psm3.SALES_MEMO_ID = pvpbt.SALES_MEMO_ID 
left join PMV_VIP_LIFETIME_SPENDING pvls 
on pvls.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID 
left join PMV_VIP_YTD_SPENDING pvys 
on pvys.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID 
left join PMV_VIP_P12_SPENDING pvps 
on pvps.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID 
left join (SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,VIP_NO,sum(POINT_MOVEMENT) as POINTS FROM dbo.PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT
Group by COMPANY_CODE,VIP_NO) pvpb 
on pvpb.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO and pvpb.COMPANY_CODE=pv.COMPANY_CODE
left join (SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,VIP_NO,sum(POINT_MOVEMENT) as REDEEM_POINTS FROM dbo.PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT WHERE MOVEMENT_TYPE='GIFT'
Group by COMPANY_CODE,VIP_NO) pvpr 
on pvpr.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO and pvpr.COMPANY_CODE=pv.COMPANY_CODE 
left join PMV_VIP_LAST_REDEMPTION pvlr 
on pvlr.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID 
left join 
(
	select
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pv2.COMPANY_CODE , pv2.VIP_NO ORDER BY psm.TX_DT DESC) AS "ROW_NUM",
	pv2.COMPANY_CODE ,
	pv2.VIP_NO ,
	--psm.LOCATION_ID_FK  as LOCATION_ID,
	pl.LOCATION_CODE  as LOCATION_ID,
	pl.LOCATION_NAME  as LOCATION_NAME,
	pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE ,
	psm.TX_DT as TX_DATE
	from PT_SALES_MEMO psm 
	inner join PM_VIP pv2 
	on psm.VIP_NO = pv2.VIP_NO 
	and psm.COMPANY_CODE = pv2.COMPANY_CODE 
	inner join PM_LOCATION pl 
	on pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK 
	inner join PM_STORE_TYPE pst
	on pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK 
) lastStore
on pv.COMPANY_CODE = lastStore.COMPANY_CODE
and pv.VIP_NO = lastStore.VIP_NO
and lastStore.ROW_NUM = 1
where psmt2.TYPE_CODE not in ('03','04','05','06','07','09','10','11','99','08')
and psm3.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED') 
and psm3.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE', 'handoff')
--and psa.IH_L1 = '110'
and psm3.VIP_NO is not NULL

	pr.TRANSACTION_DATE ,
	--pr.REDEEMED_QTY as REDEEMED_QTY ,
	--pr.POINTS_DEDUCTED as POINTS_REDEEMED
	--sb.AS_OF_QTY as STOCK_ON_HAND
	sum(pr.REDEEMED_QTY) as REDEEMED_QTY ,
	sum(pr.POINTS_DEDUCTED) as POINTS_REDEEMED,
	sb.AS_OF_QTY as STOCK_ON_HAND
	FROM PV_R0033 pr 
left join (
	select
	timbd.COMPANY_CODE ,
	timbd.LOCATION_CODE,
	timbd.BALANCE_TYPE ,
	timbd.SKU,
	timbd.OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
	timbd.BALANCE + sum(timbd.MOVEMENT_QTY) AS_OF_QTY
	from 
		PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 timbd
	inner join 
		(
			select
				a.COMPANY_CODE  , a.LOCATION_CODE, a.BALANCE_TYPE , a.SKU, max(a.OPEN_BALANCE_DT) MAX_BALANCE_DT
			from
				PV_INVENTORY_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2 a

		a.COMPANY_CODE,

CREATE   view PV_R0036A1_SUB as
-- view to get the points by COMPANY_CODE and GRADE_CODE by each MOVEMENT_DT 
select pvj.*, pvj.ISSUED_PTS+pvj.REDEEM_PTS+pvj.EXPIRED_PTS+pvj.ADJUSTMENT_PTS as tot_pts  from (
select COMPANY_CODE, VIP_GRADE_CODE, CONVERT(DATE, MOVEMENT_DT) as MOVEMENT_DT,
isnull(sum([REDEEM]), 0) as REDEEM_PTS,
isnull(sum([EXPIRED]), 0) as EXPIRED_PTS,
isnull(sum([ADJUSTMENT]), 0) as ADJUSTMENT_PTS,
isnull(sum([ISSUED]), 0) as ISSUED_PTS 
from ( SELECT pvbm.COMPANY_CODE, pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE, pvbm.VIP_NO, 
		CONVERT(DATE, pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT) as MOVEMENT_DT, pvbm.POINT_MOVEMENT,
		CASE WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='GIFT' then 'REDEEM'
			WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='EXPIRE_DATE_RESET' then 'EXPIRED' 
			WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
			ELSE 'ISSUED' END as TRANS_TYPE
		FROM PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
		LEFT JOIN PV_VIP_GRADE pvg ON pvg.COMPANY_CODE=pvbm.COMPANY_CODE and pvg.VIP_NO=pvbm.VIP_NO
		--WHERE pvbm.COMPANY_CODE='HKCL' AND pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >='2022-08-01'
		--WHERE pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >='2023-07-01' --AND pvbm.COMPANY_CODE='HKOR'
		--WHERE pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >=GETDATE()-45 
		--where pvbm.VIP_NO in ('01000050343','01000050737') 
		UNION ALL
		SELECT pvbb.COMPANY_CODE, pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE, pv.VIP_NO, CONVERT(DATE, pvbb.BALANCE_DT) as MOVEMENT_DT,
			pvbb.BALANCE as POINT_MOVEMENT, 'ISSUED' as TRANS_TYPE
		FROM PL_VIP_BP_BALANCE pvbb  
		JOIN PM_VIP pv on pv.COMPANY_CODE=pvbb.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_ID=pvbb.VIP_ID_FK  
		JOIN PV_VIP_GRADE pvg ON pvg.COMPANY_CODE=pv.COMPANY_CODE and pvg.VIP_NO=pv.VIP_NO 			
	) d
PIVOT (	SUM(POINT_MOVEMENT)
		for TRANS_TYPE in ([REDEEM], [EXPIRED], [ADJUSTMENT], [ISSUED])
	) piv 
group by COMPANY_CODE, VIP_GRADE_CODE, CONVERT(DATE, MOVEMENT_DT) 
) pvj;

CREATE   VIEW dbo.PV_R0038_DEPOSIT_ORDER AS
WITH valid_memo AS (
    SELECT
        psm.SALES_MEMO_ID,
        psm.COMPANY_CODE,
        psm.MEMO_NO,
        psm.TX_DT,
        psm.VIP_NO,
        psm.CASHIER_CODE,
        psm.LOCATION_ID_FK,
        psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK,
        psm.RESERVE_EXP_DT,
        psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT,
        psmt.TYPE_CODE
    FROM PT_SALES_MEMO psm
    INNER JOIN PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt
        ON psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
    WHERE psm.MEMO_KIND = 'NORMAL'
      AND psm.MEMO_STATUS <> 'VOIDED'
      AND psmt.TYPE_CODE <> '09'
),
orig_memo AS (
    SELECT
        vm.COMPANY_CODE,
        vm.MEMO_NO,
        psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO,
        MIN(psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK) AS SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK
    FROM valid_memo vm
    JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih
        ON psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = vm.SALES_MEMO_ID
    JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_D psmid
        ON psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID
    GROUP BY vm.COMPANY_CODE, vm.MEMO_NO, psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO
),
deposit_payments AS (
    SELECT psmp.*
    FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp
    JOIN valid_memo vm
        ON vm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
),
redeem_items AS (
    -- Item details belonging to valid memos that reference an original memo
    SELECT
        psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO,
        psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK
    FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_D psmid
    JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih
        ON psmih.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID = psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK
    JOIN valid_memo vm
        ON vm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
    WHERE psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO IS NOT NULL
),
redeem_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        orig.COMPANY_CODE,
        orig.MEMO_NO AS ORIG_MEMO_NO,
        redeem.MEMO_NO AS REDEEM_MEMO_NO
    FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_D psmid
    JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih
        ON psmih.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID = psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK
    JOIN valid_memo redeem
        ON redeem.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
    JOIN valid_memo orig
        ON orig.MEMO_NO = psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO
       AND orig.COMPANY_CODE = redeem.COMPANY_CODE
    WHERE psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    psm.COMPANY_CODE,
    pl.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCATION_CODE,
    psm.COMPANY_CODE AS DIVISION,
    'Deposit' AS ORDER_TYPE,
    pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS STORE_TYPE_NAME,
    pl.CITY_TXT AS STORE_LOCATION,
    pl.LOCATION_CODE AS STORE_ID,
    pl.LOCATION_NAME AS STORE_NAME,
    'Deposit' AS LIABILITY_TYPE,
    COALESCE(a.ORIG_MEMO_NO, psm.MEMO_NO) AS LIABILITY_ID,
    'Deposit Order' AS LIABILITY_DESCRIPTION,
    psmt.TYPE_DESC AS TRAN_TYPE,
    CASE 
        WHEN psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ID IS NULL
             AND psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK IS NULL
             AND psmt.TYPE_DESC = 'Deposit Issue'
        THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSE'
    END AS STATUS,
    psm.MEMO_NO AS TRANSACTION_NUMBER,
    CAST(psm.TX_DT AS date) AS TX_DATE,
    CAST(psm.TX_DT AS time) AS TRANSACTION_TIME,
    ps22.STAFF_CODE AS BA_ID,
    ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME AS BA_NAME,
    pv.VIP_NO AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    'NA' AS SKU10,
    'NA' AS SKU6,
    'NA' AS SKU4,
    'NA' AS PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
    0 AS QUANTITY,
    psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT AS SALES_AMOUNT,
    CASE 
        WHEN psmid.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ID_FK IS NOT NULL THEN 0
        ELSE psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT + ISNULL(psm2.TOTAL_NET_AMT, 0)
    END AS REMAINING_BALANCE,
    CAST(psm.TX_DT AS date) AS ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_DATE,
    DATEDIFF(day, CAST(psm.TX_DT AS date), GETDATE()) AS DAYS_SINCE_POURCHASE_DATE,
    psm.RESERVE_EXP_DT AS EXPIRATION_DATE,
    CASE 
        WHEN DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CAST(psm.RESERVE_EXP_DT AS date)) < 0 THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END AS EXPIRED
FROM valid_memo psm
INNER JOIN PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt
    ON psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID = psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PM_LOCATION pl
 ON pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst
    ON pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv
    ON pv.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
   AND pv.VIP_NO = psm.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_CUSTOMER pc
    ON pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN PM_STAFF ps22
    ON ps22.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
   AND ps22.STAFF_CODE = psm.CASHIER_CODE
LEFT JOIN orig_memo a
    ON a.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
   AND a.MEMO_NO = psm.MEMO_NO
LEFT JOIN valid_memo psm2
    ON psm2.COMPANY_CODE = a.COMPANY_CODE
   AND psm2.MEMO_NO = a.ORIG_MEMO_NO
LEFT JOIN deposit_payments psmp
    ON psmp.DEPOSIT_NO = psm.MEMO_NO
LEFT JOIN redeem_items psmid
    ON psmid.ORIG_MEMO_NO = psm.MEMO_NO
WHERE psmt.TYPE_CODE IN ('03', '04')

UNION

SELECT 
    redeem.COMPANY_CODE,
    pl.LOCATION_CODE AS LOCATION_CODE,
    redeem.COMPANY_CODE AS DIVISION,
    'Deposit' AS ORDER_TYPE,
    pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS STORE_TYPE_NAME,
    pl.CITY_TXT AS STORE_LOCATION,
    pl.LOCATION_CODE AS STORE_ID,
    pl.LOCATION_NAME AS STORE_NAME,
    'Deposit' AS LIABILITY_TYPE,
    orig.MEMO_NO AS LIABILITY_ID,
    'Deposit Order' AS LIABILITY_DESCRIPTION,
    'Deposit PickUp' AS TRAN_TYPE,
    'CLOSE' AS STATUS,
    redeem.MEMO_NO AS TRANSACTION_NUMBER,
    CAST(redeem.TX_DT AS date) AS TX_DATE,
    CAST(redeem.TX_DT AS time) AS TRANSACTION_TIME,
    redeem.CASHIER_CODE AS BA_ID,
    ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME AS BA_NAME,
    pv.VIP_NO AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    'NA' AS SKU10,
    'NA' AS SKU6,
    'NA' AS SKU4,
    'NA' AS PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
    0 AS QUANTITY,
    ISNULL(psmp.AMOUNT, 0) * -1 AS SALES_AMOUNT,
    0 AS REMAINING_BALANCE,
    CAST(orig.TX_DT AS date) AS ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_DATE,
    DATEDIFF(day, CAST(orig.TX_DT AS date), GETDATE()) AS DAYS_SINCE_POURCHASE_DATE,
    orig.RESERVE_EXP_DT AS EXPIRATION_DATE,
    CASE 
        WHEN DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CAST(orig.RESERVE_EXP_DT AS date)) < 0 THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END AS EXPIRED
FROM redeem_pairs a
JOIN valid_memo orig
    ON orig.COMPANY_CODE = a.COMPANY_CODE
   AND orig.MEMO_NO = a.ORIG_MEMO_NO
JOIN valid_memo redeem
    ON redeem.COMPANY_CODE = a.COMPANY_CODE
   AND redeem.MEMO_NO = a.REDEEM_MEMO_NO
JOIN PM_LOCATION pl
    ON pl.LOCATION_ID = redeem.LOCATION_ID_FK
JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst
    ON pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv
    ON pv.COMPANY_CODE = redeem.COMPANY_CODE
   AND pv.VIP_NO = redeem.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_CUSTOMER pc
    ON pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN PM_STAFF ps22
    ON ps22.COMPANY_CODE = redeem.COMPANY_CODE
   AND ps22.STAFF_CODE = redeem.CASHIER_CODE
LEFT JOIN deposit_payments psmp
    ON psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = redeem.SALES_MEMO_ID
LEFT JOIN PM_TENDER pt
    ON pt.TENDER_ID = psmp.TENDER_ID_FK
WHERE (pt.TENDER_CODE = '12' AND psmp.DEPOSIT_NO IS NOT NULL)
   OR (psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ID IS NULL AND orig.TYPE_CODE = '03');

isnull(psa.LH_L1, 'NA') as 'LOCAL_L1',
isnull(psa.LH_L2, 'NA') as 'LOCAL_L2',
isnull(psa.LH_L3, 'NA') as 'LOCAL_L3',
isnull(psa.LH_L4, 'NA') as 'LOCAL_L4',
isnull(psa.IS_HERO_PRODUCT , 'NA') as 'LOCAL_L5',
psmih.SKU as 'MATERIAL_CODE_10',
SUBSTRING(psmih.sku,1,6) as 'MATERIAL_CODE_6',
pi2.ITEM_CODE as 'MATERIAL_CODE_4',
ps3.SKU_DESC as 'PRODUCT_NAME',
pb.BRAND_DESC as 'PRODUCT_BRAND',
--case when psa.IH_L1 = '110' then 'Y' else 'N' end as 'SALEABLE',
CASE
		WHEN psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID in ('03', '04') THEN 'N'
		WHEN psa.IH_L1 = '110' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'N' then 'Y'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.IS_SALES_KIT_ITEM = 'Y' and psmih.qty < 0  then 'N'
		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' then 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'

case when psa.IH_L1 = '120' and psa.IH_L2 = '32' then 'Y' else 'N' end as 'GIFT',

psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.qty as 'SALES_VALUE',

CASE when (CASE WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '09' and psmih.NET_LINE_AMT < 0 then psmih.QTY * -1 ELSE psmih.QTY end) >= 0 then ABS(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT)
when (CASE WHEN psmt.TYPE_CODE = '09' and psmih.NET_LINE_AMT < 0 then psmih.QTY * -1 ELSE psmih.QTY end) < 0 then ABS(psmih.NET_LINE_AMT)*-1

pskh.SALES_KIT_DESC as VIRTUAL_SET_DESC,
case when psm.MEMO_STATUS = 'VOIDED' then 'Y' else 'N' end as 'POST_VOID',
CASE WHEN RIGHT(pl.COUNTRY_ID_FK,3)='MAC' THEN 'MO'
WHEN RIGHT(pl.COUNTRY_ID_FK,3)='HKG' THEN 'HK'
ELSE LEFT(pl.COMPANY_CODE,2) END as ENTITY

on pskh.COMPANY_CODE = psmiha.COMPANY_CODE 
and pskh.SKU_CODE = psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU 
inner join dbo.PM_COMPANY pc 
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE 
inner join dbo.PM_LOCATION pl 
on psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = pl.LOCATION_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst 
on pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt 
on psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_TERMINAL pt 
on psm.TERMINAL_ID_FK = pt.TERMINAL_ID 
left join dbo.PM_USER pu 
on psm.CRE_BY = pu.USER_CODE 
and pu.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE 
left join dbo.PM_STAFF ps 
on pu.STAFF_ID_FK = ps.STAFF_ID 
left join dbo.PT_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET pmiss 
on psmih.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
left join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF psmis 
on psmis.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
left join dbo.PM_STAFF ps2

and ps2.STAFF_CODE = psmis.STAFF_NO 
inner join dbo.PM_VIP pv 
on psm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO 
and psm.VIP_CLUSTER_ID_FK = pv.VIP_CLUSTER_ID_FK 
inner join dbo.PM_CUSTOMER pc2

on pc2.CUSTOMER_ID = pcs.CUSTOMER_ID_FK 
left join dbo.PM_NATION pn

-------------------

inner join dbo.PM_SKU_ATTR psa

inner join dbo.PM_ITEM pi2 
on ps3.ITEM_ID_FK = pi2.ITEM_ID

on pi2.SUBCLASS_ID_FK = ps4.SUBCLASS_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_BRAND pb 
on pi2.BRAND_ID_FK = pb.BRAND_ID

where psmt.TYPE_CODE not in ('06','07','10','11','99','08')
and psm.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE', 'handoff')
and psm.VIP_NO is not null

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R0038_SERVICE_PACKAGE] AS

'Service Package SALES' as TRAN_TYPE,
CASE when pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS is not null then 'OPEN' else 'CLOSE' end as STATUS,
pvsih.SALES_MEMO_NO as TRANSACTION_NUMBER,
COALESCE (CAST(psm.TX_DT as date),CAST(pvsih.CRE_DATET as date)) as TX_DATE,
COALESCE (CAST(psm.TX_DT as time),CAST(pvsih.CRE_DATET as time)) as TRANSACTION_TIME,
ps22.STAFF_CODE as BA_ID,
ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME as BA_NAME,
pv.VIP_NO as CUSTOMER_ID,
pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME as CUSTOMER_NAME,
pvsih.SKU_CODE as SKU10,
LEFT(pvsih.SKU_CODE,6) as SKU6 ,
LEFT(pvsih.SKU_CODE,4) as SKU4 ,
pvsih.SVC_PKG_DESC as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
1 as QUANTITY,
pvsih.SELLING_PRICE as SALES_AMOUNT,
case when pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS IN('PENDING','EXPIRED') then SUM(pvsi.PRICE) else 0 end as REMAINING_BALANCE,
CAST (pvsih.EFFECTIVE_DATE as date) as ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_DATE,
DATEDIFF(day,CAST (pvsih.EFFECTIVE_DATE as date),GETDATE()) as DAYS_SINCE_POURCHASE_DATE,
CAST (pvsih.EXPIRY_DT as date) as EXPIRATION_DATE,
CASE 
	when DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CAST(pvsih.EXPIRY_DT as date)) < 0 then 'Y'
	ELSE 'N'
END as EXPIRED
from PM_VIP_SVC_ITEM_H pvsih
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP_SVC_ITEM pvsi  ON pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID=pvsi.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID_FK and pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS IN('PENDING','EXPIRED')
LEFT JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO psm ON psm.MEMO_NO =pvsih.SALES_MEMO_NO and psm.COMPANY_CODE =pvsih.COMPANY_CODE 
LEFT JOIN PM_LOCATION pl on pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst on 	pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv on 	pv.COMPANY_CODE = pvsih.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_NO = pvsih.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_CUSTOMER pc on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN dbo.PM_STAFF ps22 on ps22.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE and ps22.STAFF_CODE = psm.CASHIER_CODE
WHERE 1=1 --and pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID='HKBBHQ000000000033359253'
GROUP BY pvsih.COMPANY_CODE, pl.LOCATION_CODE, pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE, pl.CITY_TXT, pl.LOCATION_CODE, pl.LOCATION_NAME, 
pvsih.SALES_MEMO_NO, pvsih.SKU_CODE, psm.TX_DT, ps22.STAFF_CODE, pc.FIRSTNAME, pc.SURNAME, ps22.FIRST_NAME, ps22.LAST_NAME, pv.VIP_NO,
pvsih.SVC_PKG_DESC, pvsih.EXPIRY_DT,pvsih.PACKAGE_TYPE,pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID ,pvsih.EFFECTIVE_DATE,pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS,pvsih.SELLING_PRICE,pvsih.CRE_DATET
UNION 
SELECT pvsih.COMPANY_CODE , 
pl.LOCATION_CODE as LOCATION_CODE,
pvsih.COMPANY_CODE as DIVISION,
pvsih.PACKAGE_TYPE as ORDER_TYPE,
pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE as STORE_TYPE_NAME,
pl.CITY_TXT as STORE_LOCATION,
pl.LOCATION_CODE as STORE_ID,
pl.LOCATION_NAME as STORE_NAME,
'Service Package' as LIABILITY_TYPE,
pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID as LIABILITY_ID,
'NA' as LIABILITY_DESCRIPTION,
'Service Package ' + pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS as TRAN_TYPE,
	case when SUM(
		case when pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS IN ('PENDING','EXPIRED') then pvsi.PRICE else 0 end
	) > 0 then 'OPEN' else 'CLOSE' end as STATUS,
pvsi.REDEEM_MEMO_NO as TRANSACTION_NUMBER,
COALESCE (CAST(psm.TX_DT as date),CAST(pvsih.CRE_DATET as date)) as TX_DATE,
COALESCE (CAST(psm.TX_DT as time),CAST(pvsih.CRE_DATET as time)) as TRANSACTION_TIME,
ps22.STAFF_CODE as BA_ID,
ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME as BA_NAME,
pv.VIP_NO as CUSTOMER_ID,
pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME as CUSTOMER_NAME,
pvsi.SKU_CODE as SKU10,
LEFT(pvsi.SKU_CODE,6) as SKU6 ,
LEFT(pvsi.SKU_CODE,4) as SKU4 ,
pvsi.SVC_ITEM_DESC as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
count(seq) as QUANTITY,
SUM(pvsi.PRICE)*-1 as SALES_AMOUNT,
/*SUM(
	case when pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS IN('PENDING','EXPIRED') then pvsi.PRICE else 0 end
	) as REMAINING_BALANCE,*/
case when pvsi.SVC_ITEM_STATUS IN('PENDING','EXPIRED') then pvsi.PRICE*-1 else 0 end as REMAINING_BALANCE,
CAST (pvsih.EFFECTIVE_DATE as date) as ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_DATE,
DATEDIFF(day,CAST (pvsih.EFFECTIVE_DATE as date),GETDATE()) as DAYS_SINCE_POURCHASE_DATE,
CAST (pvsih.EXPIRY_DT as date) as EXPIRATION_DATE,
CASE 
	when DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CAST(pvsih.EXPIRY_DT as date)) < 0 then 'Y'
	ELSE 'N'
END as EXPIRED
from PM_VIP_SVC_ITEM pvsi
INNER JOIN PM_VIP_SVC_ITEM_H pvsih ON pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID=pvsi.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID_FK 
LEFT JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO psm ON psm.MEMO_NO =pvsi.REDEEM_MEMO_NO 
LEFT JOIN PM_LOCATION pl on pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst on 	pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv on 	pv.COMPANY_CODE = pvsih.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_NO = pvsih.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_CUSTOMER pc on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID

WHERE 1=1 and pvsi.REDEEM_MEMO_NO is not null --and pvsih.VIP_SVC_ITEM_H_ID='HKBBHQ000000000033359253'
GROUP BY pvsih.COMPANY_CODE, pl.LOCATION_CODE, pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE, pl.CITY_TXT, pl.LOCATION_CODE, pl.LOCATION_NAME, 
pvsi.REDEEM_MEMO_NO, pvsi.SKU_CODE, psm.TX_DT, ps22.STAFF_CODE, pc.FIRSTNAME, pc.SURNAME, ps22.FIRST_NAME, ps22.LAST_NAME, pv.VIP_NO,

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R0038_STORE_CREDIT] AS
SELECT

    pl.LOCATION_CODE as LOCATION_CODE,
    psm.COMPANY_CODE as DIVISION,
    --'Store Credit Issue' as ORDER_TYPE,
    pt.tender_name as ORDER_TYPE,

    'Store Credit' as LIABILITY_TYPE,
    --psm.MEMO_NO as LIABILITY_ID,
    psmpa.STORE_CREDIT_NO as LIABILITY_ID,
    'Store Credit' as LIABILITY_DESCRIPTION,
    pt.TENDER_NAME as TRAN_TYPE,
    --case when psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ID is null then 'OPEN' else 'CLOSE' end as STATUS,  
    --CASE WHEN pt.tender_code ='106' then 'OPEN' else   'CLOSE' END as STATUS,
    CASE WHEN b.NET_BAL <>0 AND pt.TENDER_CODE ='106' then 'OPEN' else 'CLOSE' END as STATUS,--Check again 
    psm.MEMO_NO as TRANSACTION_NUMBER,
    CAST(psm.TX_DT as date) as TX_DATE,
    CAST(psm.TX_DT as time) as TRANSACTION_TIME,
    psm.CASHIER_CODE as BA_ID,
    ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME as BA_NAME,
    pv.VIP_NO as CUSTOMER_ID,
    pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME as CUSTOMER_NAME,
    'NA' as SKU10,
    'NA' as SKU6 ,
    'NA' as SKU4 ,
    'NA' as PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
     0 as QUANTITY,
   -- SUM(psmp.AMOUNT) as SALES_AMOUNT, -- visa+store credit
    psmp.AMOUNT,
    SUM(a.REMAINING_BAL) as REMAINING_BALANCE,    
   -- a.REMAINING_BAL,
    CAST (psm.TX_DT as date) as ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_DATE,
    DATEDIFF(day,CAST (psm.TX_DT as date),GETDATE()) as DAYS_SINCE_POURCHASE_DATE,
    GETDATE()+365 as EXPIRATION_DATE,
    CASE
        when DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), CAST(psm.RESERVE_EXP_DT as date)) < 0 then 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END as EXPIRED
FROM
    PT_SALES_MEMO psm
INNER JOIN PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt on psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID = psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp on psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PM_TENDER pt on psmp.TENDER_ID_FK = pt.TENDER_ID
INNER JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR psmpa on psmpa.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PM_LOCATION pl on pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK
INNER JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst on pst.STORE_TYPE_ID = pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv on pv.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_NO = psm.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_CUSTOMER pc on  pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN (select CARD_NO,MOVEMENT_DT,sum(MOVEMENT_AMT) as REMAINING_BAL from PL_GIFT_CARD_LOG pgcl 
group by CARD_NO, MOVEMENT_DT) a ON a.CARD_NO=psmpa.STORE_CREDIT_NO --and a.MOVEMENT_DT<= psm.TX_DT
LEFT JOIN (select CARD_NO,sum(MOVEMENT_AMT) as NET_BAL from PL_GIFT_CARD_LOG pgcl 
group by CARD_NO) b ON b.CARD_NO=psmpa.STORE_CREDIT_NO
LEFT join dbo.PM_STAFF ps22 on ps22.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE and ps22.STAFF_CODE = psm.CASHIER_CODE 
 where  (isnull(psmt.TYPE_CODE,0) <> '09' and isnull(psm.MEMO_STATUS,0) <> 'VOIDED')
 and PT.TENDER_CODE IN ('105','106')
 --and  psm.MEMO_NO in ('HKBB0016010J21000314','HKBB0016010J21000316')
  GROUP BY psm.COMPANY_CODE ,pl.LOCATION_CODE,pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE,pl.CITY_TXT,pl.LOCATION_CODE,
    pl.LOCATION_NAME,psm.MEMO_NO,pt.tender_name,psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ID,  psmpa.STORE_CREDIT_NO,pt.tender_code,psm.CASHIER_CODE,
    psm.MEMO_NO,psm.TX_DT,psm.TX_DT,ps22.STAFF_CODE,pv.VIP_NO,ps22.FIRST_NAME,ps22.LAST_NAME,psm.RESERVE_EXP_DT,psmp.AMOUNT,
    PC.SURNAME,PC.FIRSTNAME,b.NET_BAL

CREATE   VIEW PV_R0041 as 
select
	COMPANY_CODE,
	GC_SEQ_NO,
	CARD_NO,
	GIFT_CARD_STATUS,
	FACE_VALUE,
	BALANCE,
	EXPIRY_DATE,
	case
		when ACTIVATE_DATE is null then CRE_DATET
		else TX_DATE
	end as TX_DATE,
	case
		when ACTIVATE_DATE is null then 'NOT_ISSUED'
		when ACTIVATE_DATE is not null and row_num = 1 then 'PURCHASE'
		when ACTIVATE_DATE is not null and row_num > 1 then 'REDEMPTION'
		else null
	end as TX_TYPE,
	ISNULL(GIFT_CARD_LOG_LOCATION_CODE, GIFT_CARD_MASTER_LOCATION_CODE) AS LOCATION_CODE,
	ISNULL(GIFT_CARD_LOG_STORE_TYPE_NAME, GIFT_CARD_MASTER_STORE_TYPE_NAME) AS STORE_TYPE_NAME,	
	ORDER_NUMBER,
	case
		when row_num = cnt then 'YES'
		else null
	end as LATEST_TX
from
	PV_R0041_SUB

CREATE   VIEW PV_R0041_SUB as 
select
	pgc.COMPANY_CODE,
	pgc.GC_SEQ_NO,
	pgc.CARD_NO,
	pgc.GIFT_CARD_STATUS,
	pgc.ACTIVATE_DATE,
	pgc.CRE_DATET,
	pgc.FACE_VALUE,
	SUM(pgcl.MOVEMENT_AMT) over(PARTITION BY pgc.COMPANY_CODE, pgc.CARD_NO ORDER BY pgc.COMPANY_CODE, pgc.CARD_NO, pgcl.MOVEMENT_DT ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) as BALANCE,
	pgc.EXPIRY_DATE,
	pl.LOCATION_CODE AS GIFT_CARD_LOG_LOCATION_CODE,
	pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS GIFT_CARD_LOG_STORE_TYPE_NAME,
	pl2.LOCATION_CODE AS GIFT_CARD_MASTER_LOCATION_CODE,
	pst2.STORE_TYPE_CODE AS GIFT_CARD_MASTER_STORE_TYPE_NAME,
	pgcl.MOVEMENT_DT AS TX_DATE,
	pgcl.ORDER_NUMBER,
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pgc.COMPANY_CODE, pgc.CARD_NO ORDER BY pgc.COMPANY_CODE, pgc.CARD_NO, pgcl.MOVEMENT_DT) row_num,
	count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pgc.COMPANY_CODE, pgc.CARD_NO) cnt
from PM_GIFT_CARD pgc
left join PL_GIFT_CARD_LOG pgcl on pgc.COMPANY_CODE = pgcl.COMPANY_CODE and pgc.CARD_NO = pgcl.CARD_NO
left JOIN PM_LOCATION pl ON pgcl.COMPANY_CODE = pl.COMPANY_CODE AND pgcl.LOCATION_CODE = pl.LOCATION_CODE
left JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst ON pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID 
left JOIN PM_LOCATION pl2 ON pgc.COMPANY_CODE = pl2.COMPANY_CODE AND pgc.LOCATION_CODE = pl2.LOCATION_CODE
left JOIN PM_STORE_TYPE pst2 ON pl2.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst2.STORE_TYPE_ID 
WHERE pgc.GC_SEQ_NO IS NOT NULL

psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY as TOTAL_RETAIL_PRICE,

--CONCAT(cast(cast(psmih.LINE_DISC_AMT*100 as float)/(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE*psmih.QTY) as decimal(10,2)), '%') as DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE,
'0' as DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE,
psmih.NET_LINE_AMT as NET_SALES, 
psmih.NET_LINE_AMT as SALES_VALUE, 
psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT  as TRANSACTION_SALES_VALUE,
CASE when 
(select SUM(psmih1.QUANTITY) as t from PV_SALES_ITEM psmih1 where psmih1.SALES_MEMO_ID = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID and psmih1.MATERIAL_CODE_10 = psmih.sku AND psmih1.SALEABLE ='Y' ) > 8 
then 'Yes' else 'No' end as ITEM_LIMIT,
CASE when
(select SUM(psmih1.QUANTITY) as t from PV_SALES_ITEM psmih1 where psmih1.SALES_MEMO_ID = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID AND psmih1.SALEABLE ='Y') > 14 
then 'Yes' else 'No' end as TRAN_LIMIT,
CASE when PSM.VIP_NO IS NOT NULL then
CASE when
 (SELECT QUANTITY FROM PV_R0051_MULTIPLE A 
	WHERE A.TX_DATE=psm.TX_DATE AND A.MATERIAL_CODE_10 =psmih.SKU AND A.VIP_NO=psm.VIP_NO AND A.LOCATION_ID_FK=psm.location_id_fk) > 8
  then 'y' else 'n' end 
  else
  'n' 
  end
  as ITEM_MULTIPLE,  
   CASE when PSM.VIP_NO IS NOT NULL then
CASE when
  (SELECT SUM(QUANTITY) FROM PV_R0051_MULTIPLE A 
	WHERE A.TX_DATE=psm.TX_DATE AND A.VIP_NO=psm.VIP_NO AND A.LOCATION_ID_FK=psm.location_id_fk) > 14
 then 'Yes' ELSE 'No' end 
  else 
  'No' 
end
as TRAN_MULTIPLE

PL_AUTHORIZATION_LOG pal 
inner join PT_SALES_MEMO psm 
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pal.COMPANY_CODE 
and psm.MEMO_NO = pal.AUTH_REF_NO 
inner join PMV_SALES_ITEM_QTY psiq 
on psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psiq.SALES_MEMO_ID 
inner join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih 
on psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
inner join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR psmiha 
on psmih.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR_ID_FK = psmiha.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR_ID 
inner join dbo.PT_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET pmiss 
on psmih.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
inner join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF psmis 
on psmis.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_STAFF ps3 
on ps3.COMPANY_CODE = psmis.COMPANY_CODE 
and ps3.STAFF_CODE = psmis.STAFF_NO 
inner join PV_SKU_DETAIL psd 
on psmih.COMPANY_CODE = psd.COMPANY_CODE 
and psmih.SKU = psd.SKU_10 
inner join PM_LOCATION pl 
on pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK 
inner join PM_STORE_TYPE pst 
on pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID 
left join PM_USER pu 
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pu.COMPANY_CODE 
and psm.CRE_BY = pu.USER_CODE 
left join PM_STAFF ps 
on pu.STAFF_ID_FK = ps.STAFF_ID 
left join PM_USER pu2 
on pu2.COMPANY_CODE = pal.COMPANY_CODE 
and pu2.USER_CODE = pal.AUTH_BY 
left join PM_STAFF ps2 
on pu2.STAFF_ID_FK = ps2.STAFF_ID 
left join PM_VIP pv 
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and psm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO 
left join PM_CUSTOMER pc 
on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID 
left join PM_VIRTUAL_SET_H pvsh 
on psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU = pvsh.SKU_CODE

left join PM_SKU psV
on psV.COMPANY_CODE = pvsh.COMPANY_CODE 
and psV.SKU_CODE = pvsh.SKU_CODE 
left join PM_ITEM piV
on piV.ITEM_ID = psV.ITEM_ID_FK 
left join PMV_SALES_LOYALTY_MOVEMENT_BY_TRANSACTION pslmbt 
on pslmbt.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE 
and pslmbt.POS_MEMO_NO = psm.POS_MEMO_NO 
where
pal.AUTH_FUNCTION = 'authorizeOverPurchaseAmt'

CREATE   view [dbo].[PV_R0055] as 
select 
psm.COMPANY_CODE,
pst.STORE_TYPE_CODE as STORE_TYPE,

pl.CITY_TXT as STORE_LOCATION,

isnull(ps_cashier.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps_cashier.LAST_NAME , ps_cre.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps_cre.LAST_NAME ) as ORIGINAL_CASHIER_NAME,

psd.SKU_10 ,
psd.SKU_6 ,
psd.SKU_4 ,
psd.PRODUCT_BRAND as ORIGINAL_SUB_BRAND,
psd.PRODUCT_NAME as ORIGINAL_MATERIAL_DESC,
psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE as ORIGINAL_RETAIL_PRICE,
psmih.QTY as ORIGINAL_QTY_SOLD,
psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY as ORIGINAL_TOTAL_RETAIL_PRICE,
--(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY - psmih.NET_LINE_AMT)/(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY) * 100 as ORIGINAL_DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
CASE WHEN psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY <>0 THEN (psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY - psmih.NET_LINE_AMT)/(psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY) * 100
ELSE psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY END as ORIGINAL_DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
psmih.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE * psmih.QTY - psmih.NET_LINE_AMT as ORIGINAL_DISCOUNT_AMT,
psm.VIP_NO as ORIGINAL_CUSTOMER_ID,
--pc.FIRSTNAME + ' ' + pc.SURNAME as ORIGINAL_CUSTOMER_NAME,
' ' as ORIGINAL_CUSTOMER_NAME,
pal.AUTH_BY as POST_VOID_MANAGER_ID,
ps_auth.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps_auth.LAST_NAME as POST_VOID_MANAGER_NAME,
month(psmv.TX_DT) as POST_VOID_MONTH,
cast(psmv.TX_DT as date) as POST_VOID_DATE,
pt.TERMINAL_NO as POST_VOID_TERMINAL_ID ,
cast(psmv.TX_DT as time) as POST_VOID_TIME,
psmv.MEMO_NO as POST_VOID_TRANSACTION_ID,
--psmv.VOID_REASON as POST_VOID_REASON_CODE,
psmv.VOID_REASON +' '+PR.REASON_DESC as POST_VOID_REASON_CODE,
psmih.QTY as POST_VOID_QTY,
psmih.NET_LINE_AMT as POST_VOID_AMT
from
PT_SALES_MEMO psm 
inner join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih 
on psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
LEFT join dbo.PT_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET pmiss 
on psmih.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
LEFT join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF psmis 
on psmis.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID 
LEFT join dbo.PM_STAFF ps3 
on ps3.COMPANY_CODE = psmis.COMPANY_CODE 
and ps3.STAFF_CODE = psmis.STAFF_NO 
inner join PM_LOCATION pl 
on psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = pl.LOCATION_ID 
inner join PM_STORE_TYPE pst 
on pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID 
inner join PT_SALES_MEMO psmv
on psmv.ORI_SALES_MEMO_ID_PK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
inner join PM_TERMINAL pt 
on psmv.TERMINAL_ID_FK = pt.TERMINAL_ID 
inner join PL_AUTHORIZATION_LOG pal 
on pal.COMPANY_CODE = psmv.COMPANY_CODE 
and pal.AUTH_REF_NO = psmv.MEMO_NO 
and pal.AUTH_FUNCTION ='authorizeVoidTransaction'
left join PM_USER pu_auth
on pu_auth.COMPANY_CODE = pal.COMPANY_CODE 
and pu_auth.USER_CODE = pal.AUTH_BY 
left join PM_STAFF ps_auth
on ps_auth.STAFF_ID = pu_auth.STAFF_ID_FK 
left join PM_VIP pv 
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and psm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO 
left join PM_CUSTOMER pc 
on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID 
left join PV_SKU_DETAIL psd 
on psd.COMPANY_CODE = psmih.COMPANY_CODE 
and psd.SKU_10 = psmih.SKU 
left join PV_SALES_TENDER_BY_TRANSACTION pstbt 
on pstbt.SALES_MEMO_ID = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
left join PM_USER pu_cashier
on pu_cashier.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE 
and pu_cashier.USER_CODE = psm.CASHIER_CODE 
left join PM_STAFF ps_cashier
on pu_cashier.STAFF_ID_FK = ps_cashier.STAFF_ID 
left join PM_USER pu_cre
on psm.COMPANY_CODE = pu_cre.COMPANY_CODE 
and psm.CRE_BY = pu_cre.USER_CODE 
left join PM_STAFF ps_cre
on ps_cre.STAFF_ID = pu_cre.STAFF_ID_FK 
LEFT JOIN PM_REASON PR 
ON PR.COMPANY_CODE=psmv.COMPANY_CODE and PR.REASON_CODE = psmv.VOID_REASON
where psm.MEMO_STATUS = 'VOIDED'

--pcs.TEL1 as MOBILE,

ps22.STAFF_CODE as BA_CODE,
ps22.FIRST_NAME + ' ' + ps22.LAST_NAME as BA_NAME,
isnull(pn.DESCRIPTION, pcs.COUNTRY_RESIDENCE ) as NATIONALITY,
--cast(pv.APPLY_DATE as date) as REGISTRATION_DATE,
FORMAT(pv.APPLY_DATE,'MM/dd/yyyy') as REGISTRATION_DATE,
isnull(pcs.AGE_GRP,'') as AGE_GROUP,
isnull(pc.LANG, '') as PREFERRED_LANGUAGE,
--pl.LOCATION_CODE AS FROM_DATE,  
--pl.LOCATION_CODE AS TO_DATE,
sum(psmih.QTY )as TOTAL_QTY,
sum(psm.TOTAL_NET_AMT) as NET_SALES_AMT

inner join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih 
on psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
inner join PM_VIP pv 
on pv.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE 
and pv.VIP_NO = psm.VIP_NO 
inner join PM_CUSTOMER pc 
on pv.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID 
inner join PM_CUSTOMER_SECRET pcs 
on pcs.CUSTOMER_ID_FK = pc.CUSTOMER_ID 
inner join PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt 
on psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID  = psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK 
inner join PM_LOCATION pl

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R0082] AS
select
	memo.COMPANY_CODE,
	isnull(staff.STAFF_CODE, ' ') STAFF_CODE,
	isnull(staff.STAFF_CODE , ' ') STAFF_NO,
	isnull(pu.NAME, ' ') FIRST_NAME,
	isnull(' ', ' ') LAST_NAME,
	isnull(memo.COMPANY_CODE , ' ') BRAND_CODE,
	isnull(pc.COMPANY_DESC , ' ') BRAND_DESC,
	loc.LOCATION_CODE,
	psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU as VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_ITEM_CODE,
	pvss.REF_SKU_DESC  as VIRTUAL_SET_ITEM_DESC,
	psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU as VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU,
 	memo.TX_DATE as TX_DT,
	sum(itemh.QTY)/pvss.SET_QTY VIRTUAL_SET_QTY,
	sum(itemh.NET_LINE_AMT) NET_LINE_AMT
from
	PT_SALES_MEMO memo
inner join PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt ON memo.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
inner join PM_COMPANY pc ON memo.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN PM_LOCATION loc ON memo.LOCATION_ID_FK = loc.LOCATION_ID 	AND loc.COMPANY_CODE = memo.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H itemh ON memo.sales_memo_id = itemh.sales_memo_id_fk and itemh.COMPANY_CODE = memo.COMPANY_CODE
INNER JOIN dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR psmiha ON psmiha.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR_ID = itemh.SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H_ATTR_ID_FK  and psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU is not NULL
LEFT JOIN dbo.PV_VIRTUAL_SET_SUMMARY pvss ON pvss.COMPANY_CODE = psmiha.COMPANY_CODE and pvss.SKU_CODE  = psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU
LEFT JOIN PT_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET pmiss ON itemh.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID
LEFT JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_STAFF psmis ON psmis.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID_FK = pmiss.MEMO_ITEM_STAFF_SET_ID
left join PM_SKU sku ON itemh.sku = sku.sku_code and sku.COMPANY_CODE = itemh.COMPANY_CODE
left join PM_ITEM item ON sku.ITEM_ID_FK = item.ITEM_ID and item.COMPANY_CODE = sku.COMPANY_CODE
inner join PM_USER pu ON psmis.STAFF_NO = pu.USER_CODE and psmis.COMPANY_CODE = pu.COMPANY_CODE
LEFT JOIN PM_STAFF staff ON pu.STAFF_ID_FK = staff.STAFF_ID 
left join PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp ON psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = memo.SALES_MEMO_ID and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is not null
where
	psmt.TYPE_CODE not in ('05', '06', '07', '09', '10', '11', '99', '08')
	and memo.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')
	and memo.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE', 'handoff')
	and memo.PICKUP_STATUS <> 'PICKUPED'
	and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is null
	--and memo.COMPANY_CODE like 'TWEL%'
	--and memo.TX_DATE >='2022-06-08'
group by
	memo.COMPANY_CODE,
	staff.STAFF_CODE,
	pu.NAME,
 	pc.COMPANY_DESC,
	loc.LOCATION_CODE,
	psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU ,
	pvss.REF_SKU_DESC ,pvss.SET_QTY,
	psmiha.VIRTUAL_SET_PARENT_SKU,
 	memo.TX_DATE

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R0084] as 
SELECT DISTINCT pvgcl.COMPANY_CODE ,
pv.VIP_NO ,
dt.TX_DATE,
dt.MEMO_NO,
dt.POS_MEMO_NO,
pm.LOCATION_CODE,
dt.TOTAL_NET_AMT,

pvg2.VIP_GRADE_DESCRIPTION as CURRENT_TIER,

pvt.EXPIRY_DAY as MEM_END_DATE,
ISNULL(pvps.LIFETIME_SPEND,0) as LIFETIME_SPEND ,
ISNULL(pvpb.POINTS,0) as BALANCE,
pvt.EXPIRY_DAY as PT_EXP_DATE,
pvg.VIP_GRADE_DESCRIPTION as PREVIOUS_TIER
FROM PL_VIP_GRADE_CHG_LOG pvgcl 
INNER JOIN PM_VIP pv on pv.VIP_NO = pvgcl.VIP_NO  and pv.COMPANY_CODE =pvgcl.COMPANY_CODE 
INNER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,VIP_NO ,CRE_DATET,TX_DATE,MEMO_NO,POS_MEMO_NO ,LOCATION_ID_FK,TOTAL_NET_AMT  from PT_SALES_MEMO psm
WHERE DATEDIFF(day,TX_DATE ,CRE_DATET) >0 and MEMO_NO is NOT NULL and VIP_NO is NOT NULL) dt ON dt.COMPANY_CODE=pvgcl.COMPANY_CODE and dt.VIP_NO=pv.VIP_NO
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP_TYPE pvt on pvt.VIP_TYPE_ID =pv.VIP_TYPE_ID_FK and pvt.COMPANY_CODE =pv.COMPANY_CODE
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP_GRADE pvg ON pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE =pvgcl.VIP_GRADE_FROM and pvg.COMPANY_CODE =pvgcl.COMPANY_CODE 
LEFT JOIN PM_VIP_GRADE pvg2 ON pvg2.VIP_GRADE_CODE =pvgcl.VIP_GRADE_TO and pvg2.COMPANY_CODE =pvgcl.COMPANY_CODE
LEFT JOIN PMV_VIP_P12_SPENDING pvps ON pvps.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID
