CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[PV_R8802_BASE] AS 
SELECT
  COMPANY_CODE,
	BRAND_CODE,
	LOCATION_CODE,
	concat(LOCATION_CODE, '-', LOCATION_DESC) as LOCATION_DESC,
	CONVERT(varchar(100),DATEADD(YEAR,-1, F_TX_DT),111) lf,
	F_TX_DT,
	WEEK_NAME,
	TG_AMT,
	NET_LINE_AMT,
	Convert(decimal(18, 2),
	(CASE
		WHEN TG_AMT = 0
		AND NET_LINE_AMT <= 0 THEN 0
		WHEN TG_AMT = 0
		AND NET_LINE_AMT>0 THEN 100
		ELSE (NET_LINE_AMT / TG_AMT)* 100
	END) ) DAILY_COMP_PCT,
	0 CUMULATIVE_COMP_PCT,
	0 CUMULATIVE_ADD,
	PERSON_COUNT,
	SAL_QTY,
	Convert(decimal(18, 2),
	(CASE
		WHEN PERSON_COUNT <= 0 THEN 0
		ELSE NET_LINE_AMT / PERSON_COUNT
	END) ) CUST_UNIT_PRICE,
	Convert(decimal(18, 2),
	(CASE
		WHEN PERSON_COUNT = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE ((SAL_QTY*1.0)/ PERSON_COUNT)
	END) ) CUST_QTY,
	CUMULATIVE_TG_AMT,
	CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT
FROM
	(
	select
		top 100 percent tg.COMPANY_CODE COMPANY_CODE, 
    tg.COMPANY_CODE BRAND_CODE,
    tg.COMPANY_DESC BRAND_DESC,
    tg.TG_LOCATION_CODE LOCATION_CODE,
    tg.TG_LOCATION_DESC LOCATION_DESC,
    tg.DATE_FROM F_TX_DT,
    datename(weekday,tg.DATE_FROM) WEEK_NAME,
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),isnull(tg.TARGET_AMOUNT, 0)) TG_AMT, 
    0 AS CUMULATIVE_TG_AMT, 
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),ISNULL(NET_LINE_AMT,0)) NET_LINE_AMT, 
    0 AS CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT, 
    ISNULL(PERSON_COUNT, 0) PERSON_COUNT,
    ISNULL(SAL_QTY, 0) SAL_QTY,
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),
		(CASE
			WHEN SAL_QTY = 0 THEN NET_LINE_AMT
			ELSE NET_LINE_AMT / SAL_QTY
		END)) CUST_UNIT_PRICE
	from
		(
		select
			memo.COMPANY_CODE,
			--                 pc.EXT_DIVISION_CODE as BRAND_CODE,
      memo.COMPANY_CODE as BRAND_CODE, pc.COMPANY_DESC as BRAND_DESC, loc.LOCATION_CODE, loc.LOCATION_ID, loc.LOCATION_DESC as LOCATION_DESC,
			--CONVERT(varchar(100), memo.TX_DT, 111) F_TX_DT,
      memo.TX_DATE as F_TX_DT, datename(weekday,
			memo.TX_DATE) WEEK_NAME, 
--			count(distinct memo.POS_MEMO_NO) PERSON_COUNT,
		    count(distinct( case when memo.TXN_MODE <> 'IOU' then memo.POS_MEMO_NO end)) PERSON_COUNT,  
			sum(itemh.QTY) SAL_QTY, sum(itemh.NET_LINE_AMT) NET_LINE_AMT
		from
			PT_SALES_MEMO memo
		inner join PM_COMPANY pc on
			memo.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE
		inner join PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt on
			memo.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
		left join PM_LOCATION loc on
			memo.LOCATION_ID_FK = loc.LOCATION_ID
			and loc.COMPANY_CODE = memo.COMPANY_CODE
		left join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H itemh on
			memo.sales_memo_id = itemh.sales_memo_id_fk
			and itemh.COMPANY_CODE = memo.COMPANY_CODE
		left join PM_SKU sku on
			itemh.sku = sku.sku_code
			and sku.COMPANY_CODE = itemh.COMPANY_CODE
		left join PM_ITEM item on
			sku.ITEM_ID_FK = item.ITEM_ID
			and item.COMPANY_CODE = sku.COMPANY_CODE
		left join PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp on
			psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = memo.SALES_MEMO_ID
			and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is not null
		WHERE
			psmt.TYPE_CODE not in ('05',
			'06',
			'07',
			'09',
			'10',
			'11',
			'99',
			'08')
			and memo.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')
			and memo.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE',
			'handoff')
			and memo.PICKUP_STATUS <> 'PICKUPED'
			and itemh.ORG_RETAIL_PRICE <> 0
			and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is null
		group by
			memo.COMPANY_CODE,
			--pc.EXT_DIVISION_CODE,
 pc.COMPANY_DESC, loc.LOCATION_CODE, loc.LOCATION_DESC, loc.LOCATION_ID,
			--									 CONVERT(varchar(100), memo.TX_DT, 111)
 memo.TX_DATE ) bs
	right join (select t.*,c.COMPANY_DESC,l.LOCATION_CODE as TG_LOCATION_CODE,l.LOCATION_DESC AS TG_LOCATION_DESC from PM_SALES_TARGET t
                             inner join PM_COMPANY c on t.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
                             inner join PM_LOCATION l on l.COMPANY_CODE = t.COMPANY_CODE and t.LOCATION_ID_FK=l.LOCATION_ID where t.SALES_TARGET_TYPE = 'DAILY' and t.STAFF_NO is null
                           
            ) tg on
		bs.LOCATION_ID = tg.LOCATION_ID_FK
		and bs.F_TX_DT = tg.DATE_FROM
		and tg.SALES_TARGET_TYPE = 'DAILY'
		and tg.STAFF_NO is null
	ORDER BY
		COMPANY_CODE, BRAND_CODE, BRAND_DESC, LOCATION_CODE, F_TX_DT ) cust

   PV_R8802_BASE C

        C.LOCATION_CODE=L.LOCATION_CODE AND 
       CONVERT(varchar(100), DATEADD(YEAR,-1,C.F_TX_DT), 111) = L.F_TX_DT

		AND CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT>0 THEN 100
		ELSE (CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT / CUMULATIVE_TG_AMT)* 100
	END) ) CUMULATIVE_COMP_PCT,
	0 CUMULATIVE_ADD,
	PERSON_COUNT,
	SAL_QTY,
	Convert(decimal(18, 2),
	(CASE
		WHEN PERSON_COUNT <= 0 THEN 0
		ELSE NET_LINE_AMT / PERSON_COUNT
	END) ) CUST_UNIT_PRICE,
	Convert(decimal(18, 2),
	(CASE
		WHEN PERSON_COUNT = 0 THEN 0
		ELSE ((SAL_QTY*1.0)/ PERSON_COUNT)
	END) ) CUST_QTY,
	CUMULATIVE_TG_AMT,
	CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT
FROM
	(
	select
		top 100 percent tg.COMPANY_CODE COMPANY_CODE, 
     tg.COMPANY_CODE BRAND_CODE,
     tg.COMPANY_DESC BRAND_DESC,
     tg.TG_LOCATION_CODE LOCATION_CODE,
     tg.TG_LOCATION_DESC LOCATION_DESC,
     TG_POS_URL AS POS_URL,
     TG_CLIENT_URL AS CLIENT_URL,
     tg.DATE_FROM F_TX_DT,
     datename(weekday,tg.DATE_FROM) WEEK_NAME,
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),
		isnull(tg.TARGET_AMOUNT, 0)) TG_AMT, 
    0 AS CUMULATIVE_TG_AMT, 
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),ISNULL(NET_LINE_AMT,0)) NET_LINE_AMT,
    0 AS CUMULATIVE_LINE_AMT, 
    isnull(PERSON_COUNT,0) PERSON_COUNT,
    isnull(SAL_QTY, 0) SAL_QTY,
    Convert(decimal(18, 2),
		(CASE
			WHEN SAL_QTY = 0 THEN NET_LINE_AMT
			ELSE NET_LINE_AMT / SAL_QTY
		END)) CUST_UNIT_PRICE
	from
		(
		select
			memo.COMPANY_CODE,
			--                 pc.EXT_DIVISION_CODE as BRAND_CODE,
 memo.COMPANY_CODE as BRAND_CODE, pc.COMPANY_DESC as BRAND_DESC, loc.LOCATION_CODE, loc.LOCATION_DESC, loc.LOCATION_ID, loc.POS_URL, loc.CLIENT_URL as CLIENT_URL,
			--								 CONVERT(varchar(100), memo.TX_DT, 111) F_TX_DT,
 memo.TX_DATE as F_TX_DT, datename(weekday,
			memo.TX_DATE ) WEEK_NAME, count(distinct(case when memo.TXN_MODE <> 'IOU' then memo.POS_MEMO_NO end)) PERSON_COUNT, sum(itemh.QTY) SAL_QTY, sum(itemh.NET_LINE_AMT) NET_LINE_AMT
		from
			PT_SALES_MEMO memo
		inner join PM_COMPANY pc on
			memo.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE
		inner join PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt on
			memo.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
		left join PM_LOCATION loc on
			memo.LOCATION_ID_FK = loc.LOCATION_ID
		left join PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H itemh on
			memo.sales_memo_id = itemh.sales_memo_id_fk
		left join PM_SKU sku on
			itemh.COMPANY_CODE = sku.COMPANY_CODE
			and itemh.sku = sku.sku_code
		left join PM_ITEM item on
			sku.ITEM_ID_FK = item.ITEM_ID
		left join PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp on
			psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = memo.SALES_MEMO_ID
			and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is not null
		where
			psmt.TYPE_CODE not in ('05',
			'06',
			'07',
			'09',
			'10',
			'11',
			'99',
			'08')
			and memo.MEMO_STATUS not in ('VOIDED')
			and memo.MEMO_KIND not in ('RESERVE',
			'handoff')
			and memo.PICKUP_STATUS <> 'PICKUPED'
			and psmp.DEPOSIT_NO is null
			and itemh.ORG_RETAIL_PRICE <> 0
		group by
			memo.COMPANY_CODE,
			-- pc.EXT_DIVISION_CODE,
 pc.COMPANY_DESC, loc.LOCATION_CODE, loc.LOCATION_DESC, loc.LOCATION_ID, loc.POS_URL, loc.CLIENT_URL,
			--									 CONVERT(varchar(100), memo.TX_DT, 111)
 memo.TX_DATE ) bs
	right join (select t.*,c.COMPANY_DESC,l.LOCATION_CODE as TG_LOCATION_CODE,l.LOCATION_DESC AS TG_LOCATION_DESC,l.POS_URL AS TG_POS_URL,l.CLIENT_URL as TG_CLIENT_URL from PM_SALES_TARGET t
                             inner join PM_COMPANY c on t.COMPANY_CODE = c.COMPANY_CODE
                             inner join PM_LOCATION l on l.COMPANY_CODE = t.COMPANY_CODE and t.LOCATION_ID_FK=l.LOCATION_ID WHERE t.SALES_TARGET_TYPE = 'DAILY' and t.STAFF_NO is null
            ) tg on
		bs.LOCATION_ID = tg.LOCATION_ID_FK
		and bs.F_TX_DT = tg.DATE_FROM
		and tg.SALES_TARGET_TYPE = 'DAILY'
		and STAFF_NO is null
	ORDER BY
		POS_URL, BRAND_CODE, BRAND_DESC, LOCATION_CODE, LOCATION_DESC, F_TX_DT ) cust

 memo.TX_DATE as TX_DT,

 pc.COMPANY_DESC,

		WHEN psmih.IS_REDEEM_SERVICE_ITEM = 'Y' then 'Y'

CREATE VIEW PV_SALES_TENDER_BY_TRANSACTION
AS
select
	psm.SALES_MEMO_ID as SALES_MEMO_ID,
	psm.POS_MEMO_NO as POS_MEMO_NO,
	stuff((SELECT DISTINCT ',' + pt.TENDER_NAME 
		FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp

		on psmp.TENDER_ID_FK = pt.TENDER_ID
		WHERE psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK 
		FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') as TENDERS,
	trace_data.TRACE_NO

	dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm
	OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT
			NULLIF(
				stuff((
					SELECT DISTINCT ',' + pt.CARD_NO
					FROM PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp
					LEFT JOIN PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR pt ON psmp.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR_ID_FK = pt.SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT_ATTR_ID
					LEFT JOIN PM_TENDER pmt ON psmp.TENDER_ID_FK = pmt.TENDER_ID
					WHERE psm.SALES_MEMO_ID = psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK
					  AND pmt.TENDER_CODE = 164
					FOR XML PATH('')
				), 1, 1, ''),
			'') AS TRACE_NO
	) trace_data

CREATE   view PV_SKU_DETAIL as 
SELECT  
--ps.SKU_CODE 
ps.COMPANY_CODE,
ps.SKU_ID ,
ps.SKU_CODE as SKU_10,
left(ps.SKU_CODE,9) as SKU_9,
left(ps.SKU_CODE,6) as SKU_6,
left(ps.SKU_CODE,4) as SKU_4,
isnull(ps.SKU_DESC, pi2.ITEM_DESC_1 ) as PRODUCT_NAME,
CASE when psa.IH_L1 = '110' then 'Saleable'
when psa.IH_L1 = '120' then 'Promotional'
when psa.IH_L1 = '130' then 'Collateral'
when psa.IH_L1 = '140' then 'Non-Inventoried Materials'
Else 'Others' end as PRODUCT_TYPE,
pb.BRAND_DESC as PRODUCT_BRAND,
pi2.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE as MAJOR_CATEGORY,
pb2.BU_DESC as MAJOR_CATEGORY_DESC,
pi2.DEPT_CODE as APPLICATION,
pd.DEPT_NAME as APPLICATION_DESC,
pc3.CLASS_CODE as CATEGORY,
pc3.CLASS_DESC as CATEGORY_DESC,
ps2.SUBCLASS_CODE as SUB_CATEGORY,
ps2.SUBCLASS_DESC as SUB_CATEGORY_DESC,
pvu.VENDOR_UPC_CODE as UPC,
concat(psa.IH_L1,psa.IH_L2,psa.IH_L3) as INVENTORY_HIER,
isnull(psa.LH_L1, 'NA') as LH_L1,
isnull(psa.LH_L2, 'NA') as LH_L2,
isnull(psa.LH_L3, 'NA') as LH_L3,
isnull(psa.LH_L4, 'NA') as LH_L4,
isnull(psa.IS_HERO_PRODUCT, 'N') as LH_L5,
psa.IH_L1 as IH_L1,
psa.IH_L2 as IH_L2,
psa.IH_L3 as IH_L3,
CASE when psa.IH_L1 = '140' and  psa.IH_L2 = '55' and psa.IH_L3 = '12' then 'Y' ELSE 'N' end as IS_SERVICE_ITEM,
ISNULL(ptip.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE,0) as RETAIL_PRICE,
ptip.D_CHAIN as D_CHAIN
FROM  PM_SKU ps 
inner join dbo.PM_SKU_ATTR psa 
on ps.SKU_ATTR_ID_FK = psa.SKU_ATTR_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_ITEM pi2 
on ps.ITEM_ID_FK = pi2.ITEM_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_CLASS pc3 
on pi2.CLASS_ID_FK = pc3.CLASS_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_SUBCLASS ps2 
on pi2.SUBCLASS_ID_FK = ps2.SUBCLASS_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_BRAND pb 
on pi2.BRAND_ID_FK = pb.BRAND_ID 
-- left join PM_VENDOR_UPC pvu 
-- on pvu.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE 
-- and pvu.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE 
left join (
	select 
		SKU,
		COMPANY_CODE,
		VENDOR_UPC_CODE,
		ROW_NUMBER() over ( 
			partition by SKU, COMPANY_CODE
			order by CRE_DATET desc ) as RN
			from PM_VENDOR_UPC
) pvu
on pvu.SKU = ps.SKU_CODE
and pvu.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE
and pvu.RN = 1
inner join PM_BU pb2
on pb2.COMPANY_CODE = ps.COMPANY_CODE 
and pb2.BU_CODE = pi2.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE 
inner join PM_DEPT pd
on pd.COMPANY_CODE = pi2.COMPANY_CODE 
and pd.DEPT_CODE = pi2.DEPT_CODE 
and pd.BU_ID_FK = pb2.BU_ID 
left join PV_TODAY_ITEM_PRICE ptip 
on ps.SKU_ID = ptip.SKU_ID_FK;

CREATE   VIEW PV_VIP_BP_CURRENT_BALANCE as 
select 
pv.VIP_ID , 
isnull(pvbb.BALANCE, 0) + isnull(sum(pvbm.POINT_MOVEMENT), 0) as CURRENT_POINT_BALANCE
--isnull(pvbb.BALANCE, 0),
--pvbm.POINT_MOVEMENT
from PM_VIP pv 
inner join PM_VIP_TYPE pvt 
on pvt.VIP_TYPE_ID = pv.VIP_TYPE_ID_FK 
inner join PM_VIP_ATTR pva 
on pva.VIP_ATTR_ID = pv.VIP_ATTR_ID_FK 
left join PV_VIP_MAX_POINT_BALANCE pvmpb 
on pvmpb.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID 
and pvmpb.BALANCE_DT <= pva.BONUS_EXP_DT 
and pvmpb.BALANCE_DT >= pva.BONUS_START_DT
left join PL_VIP_BP_BALANCE pvbb 
on pvbb.VIP_ID_FK = pvmpb.VIP_ID 
and pvbb.BALANCE_DT = pvmpb.BALANCE_DT 
left join PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
on pvbm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and pvbm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO 
and (pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT <= pva.BONUS_EXP_DT or pva.BONUS_EXP_DT is null)
and pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pva.BONUS_START_DT 
and (pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pvmpb.BALANCE_DT or pvmpb.BALANCE_DT is null)
where 1 = 1 
--and pv.COMPANY_CODE = 'HKOR' 
--and pv.VIP_ID = 'HKORHQ000001104'
--and pvmpb.BALANCE > 0
--and pv.COMPANY_CODE = 'HKOR'
group by 
pv.VIP_ID , 
pvbb.BALANCE

CREATE   view [dbo].[PV_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT_BY_DAY_V2] as 
select
coalesce (pvbb.BALANCE_DT, '2018-01-01') as OPEN_BALANCE_DT,
coalesce (pvbb.BALANCE , 0) as BALANCE,
coalesce (pvbm.COMPANY_CODE, pvbb.COMPANY_CODE) as COMPANY_CODE ,
coalesce (pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT , '2018-01-01') as MOVEMENT_DATE ,
coalesce (pvbm.VIP_NO , pvbb.VIP_NO ) as VIP_NO,
sum(coalesce (POINT_MOVEMENT ,0) ) as POINT_MOVEMENT 
from
	PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
full outer join (Select pvbb1.COMPANY_CODE , pvbb1.BALANCE_DT, pv.VIP_NO,pvbb1.BALANCE from PL_VIP_BP_BALANCE pvbb1
inner JOIN PM_VIP pv ON pv.COMPANY_CODE =pvbb1.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_ID=pvbb1.VIP_ID_FK ) pvbb
on pvbm.COMPANY_CODE = pvbb.COMPANY_CODE 
and pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pvbb.BALANCE_DT 
and pvbm.VIP_NO = pvbb.VIP_NO  
--where (pvbm.VIP_NO ='HQ001068543' or  pvbb.VIP_NO = 'HQ001068543') and pvbm.COMPANY_CODE ='HKCL'
group by

CREATE   view  PV_VIP_CURR_TIER_SPENDING as 
select
	pv.COMPANY_CODE ,
	pv.VIP_ID ,
	pv.VIP_CLUSTER_ID_FK ,
	pv.VIP_NO ,
	pv.START_DT ,
	pv.EXPIRY_DT ,
	case when isnull(sum(pvsm.POINT_MOVEMENT),0) + isnull(pvbb.BALANCE, 0) >= 0 then isnull(sum(pvsm.POINT_MOVEMENT),0) + isnull(pvbb.BALANCE, 0)
	else 0
	end as CURR_TIER_SPENDING
from
	PM_VIP pv
inner join PM_VIP_TYPE pvt 
on pv.VIP_TYPE_ID_FK =pvt.VIP_TYPE_ID
left join PV_VIP_CURR_TIER_SP_OPENING_BALANCE_DT pvctsobd on
	pvctsobd.VIP_ID = pv.VIP_ID
left join PL_VIP_SP_BALANCE pvbb on
	pvbb.VIP_ID_FK = pv.VIP_ID
	and pvbb.BALANCE_DT = pvctsobd.MAX_BALANCE_DT
left join PL_VIP_SP_MOVEMENT pvsm on
	pvsm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
	and pvsm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO
	and pvsm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pvt.START_DATE 
	and (pvt.EXPIRY_DAY is null OR pvsm.MOVEMENT_DT <= dateadd(day, 1, pvt.EXPIRY_DAY))
	and pvsm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pvctsobd.MAX_BALANCE_DT
	and (pvsm.OLD_VIP_GRADE_CODE is null OR pvsm.OLD_VIP_GRADE_CODE =pvt.TYPE_CODE)
group by
	pv.COMPANY_CODE ,
	pv.VIP_ID ,
	pv.VIP_CLUSTER_ID_FK ,
	pv.VIP_NO,
	pv.START_DT ,
	pv.EXPIRY_DT ,
	pvctsobd.MAX_BALANCE_DT ,
	pvbb.BALANCE

create   view PV_VIP_POINT_EXPIRY_SUMMARY as 
select 
pv.COMPANY_CODE ,
pv.VIP_ID ,
pv.VIP_NO ,
pv.START_DT as START_DT ,
pva.BONUS_EXP_DT as EXPIRY_DT ,
isnull(max(pvbb.BALANCE),0) + sum(isnull(pvbm.POINT_MOVEMENT,0)) as POINT_BALANCE
from PM_VIP pv 
inner join PM_VIP_ATTR pva 
on pva.VIP_ATTR_ID = pv.VIP_ATTR_ID_FK 
inner join PM_COUNTRY pc 
on pv.COMPANY_CODE = pc.COMPANY_CODE 
--and pc.COUNTRY_CODE_ISO3 = 'TWN'
left join PL_VIP_BP_BALANCE pvbb 
on pvbb.VIP_ID_FK = pv.VIP_ID 
and pvbb.BALANCE_DT >= pva.BONUS_START_DT 
and pvbb.BALANCE_DT <= pva.BONUS_EXP_DT 
left join PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
on pvbm.COMPANY_CODE = pv.COMPANY_CODE 
and pvbm.VIP_NO = pv.VIP_NO 
and pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT >= pva.BONUS_START_DT 
and pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT <= pva.BONUS_EXP_DT 
where 
pva.BONUS_EXP_DT is not null
and (pvbb.VIP_BP_BALANCE_ID is not null or pvbm.VIP_BP_MOVEMENT_ID is not null)
and (pva.RESET_EXPIRED_BONUS_POINT_DT is null or (pv.START_DT is not null and pva.RESET_EXPIRED_BONUS_POINT_DT < pv.START_DT))
group by 
pv.COMPANY_CODE ,
pv.VIP_ID ,
pv.VIP_NO ,
pv.START_DT ,
pva.BONUS_EXP_DT

 FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') as AS_OF_DATE,

	(

CREATE view [dbo].[R0002_TENDER] as 
SELECT
	psm.company_code AS 'COMPANY_CODE',
	PC2.COMPANY_DESC AS company_desc,
	pl.location_code,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC, 
	PL.CITY_TXT AS address,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_CODE as STORE_TYPE_NAME,
	pt2.TERMINAL_NO,
	CONVERT(varchar(10),
	psm.TX_DT,
	126) AS 'TX_DATE',
	pt.TENDER_CODE ,
	pt.TENDER_NAME ,
	sum(psmp.AMOUNT ) as SALES_AMOUNT,
	count(DISTINCT SALES_MEMO_ID ) as MEMO_COUNT,
	sum(skucount.QTY) as QTY
	--COUNT(DISTINCT psm.MEMO_NO) as 'MEMO_COUNT'
	FROM dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO psm
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_SALES_MEMO_TYPE psmt ON
	psm.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID_FK = psmt.SALES_MEMO_TYPE_ID
inner join dbo.PT_SALES_MEMO_PAYMENT psmp ON
	psmp.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_TENDER pt on
	psmp.TENDER_ID_FK = pt.TENDER_ID 
inner join dbo.PM_LOCATION pl on 
	pl.LOCATION_ID = psm.LOCATION_ID_FK 
INNER JOIN dbo.PM_STORE_TYPE pst ON
	pl.STORE_TYPE_ID_FK = pst.STORE_TYPE_ID
inner join dbo.PM_COMPANY pc2
on pc2.COMPANY_CODE = psm.COMPANY_CODE
inner join PM_TERMINAL pt2
on psm.TERMINAL_ID_FK = pt2.TERMINAL_ID
inner join 
(select psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK , sum(qty) as QTY from PT_SALES_MEMO_ITEM_H psmih group by psmih.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK ) skucount
on skucount.SALES_MEMO_ID_FK = psm.SALES_MEMO_ID 
WHERE
	psmt.TYPE_CODE NOT IN (
	'06',
	'07',
	'09',
	'10',
	'11',
	'99',
	'08')
	AND psm.MEMO_STATUS NOT IN ('VOIDED')
	AND psm.MEMO_KIND NOT IN ('RESERVE',
	'handoff')
	AND pst.STORE_TYPE_NAME <> 'ONLINE'
and psm.LOCATION_ID_FK = 'HKCMHKCM0012'
and psm.TX_DT >= '2021-01-13' 
and psm.TX_DT < '2021-01-14' 
GROUP BY
	psm.company_code ,
	PC2.COMPANY_DESC ,
	pl.location_code,
	PL.LOCATION_DESC, 
	PL.CITY_TXT ,
	PST.STORE_TYPE_CODE,
	pt2.TERMINAL_NO,
	CONVERT(varchar(10),
	psm.TX_DT,
	126) ,
	pt.TENDER_CODE ,
	pt.TENDER_NAME

on pp.SKU_ID_FK = psd.SKU_ID 
inner join
PM_PRICE_BOOK ppb 
on pp.PRICE_BOOK_ID_FK = ppb.PRICE_BOOK_ID 
left join PM_PRICE pp3 
on pp3.SKU_ID_FK = pp.SKU_ID_FK 
and pp3.EFFECTIVE_DT = (select min(pp2.EFFECTIVE_DT ) from PM_PRICE pp2 where pp2.SKU_ID_FK = pp3.SKU_ID_FK and pp2.EFFECTIVE_DT > pp.EFFECTIVE_DT and ppb.DESCRIPTION <> 'DEFAULT')
left join PM_PRICE_BOOK ppb2 
on pp3.PRICE_BOOK_ID_FK = ppb2.PRICE_BOOK_ID 
and ppb2.DESCRIPTION <> 'DEFAULT'
where ppb.DESCRIPTION <> 'DEFAULT'
and pp.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE <> pp3.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE 
group by 
ppb.DESCRIPTION,
psd.SKU_10 ,
psd.SKU_6 ,
psd.SKU_4 ,
psd.PRODUCT_NAME ,
psd.UPC ,
psd.COMPANY_CODE ,
psd.PRODUCT_BRAND ,
psd.MAJOR_CATEGORY + ' ' + psd.MAJOR_CATEGORY_DESC ,
psd.APPLICATION + ' ' + psd.APPLICATION_DESC ,
psd.CATEGORY +' ' + psd.CATEGORY_DESC ,
psd.SUB_CATEGORY + ' ' + psd.SUB_CATEGORY_DESC ,
psd.INVENTORY_HIER ,
pp.EFFECTIVE_DT ,
pp.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE ,
CONVERT(varchar(10), pp3.EFFECTIVE_DT, 126) ,
pp3.CUR_RETAIL_PRICE

CREATE   view [dbo].[TW_TOTAL_PTS_BY_VIP] as
select pvj.*, pvj.ISSUED_PTS+pvj.REDEEM_PTS+pvj.EXPIRED_PTS+pvj.ADJUSTMENT_PTS as tot_pts  from (
select COMPANY_CODE, VIP_GRADE_CODE,VIP_NO ,
isnull(sum([REDEEM]), 0) as REDEEM_PTS,
isnull(sum([EXPIRED]), 0) as EXPIRED_PTS,
isnull(sum([ADJUSTMENT]), 0) as ADJUSTMENT_PTS,
isnull(sum([ISSUED]), 0) as ISSUED_PTS
from ( SELECT pvbm.COMPANY_CODE, pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE, pvbm.VIP_NO, 
		CONVERT(DATE, pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT) as MOVEMENT_DT, pvbm.POINT_MOVEMENT,
		CASE WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='GIFT' then 'REDEEM'
			WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='EXPIRE_DATE_RESET' then 'EXPIRED' 
			WHEN pvbm.MOVEMENT_TYPE ='ADJUSTMENT' then 'ADJUSTMENT'
			ELSE 'ISSUED' END as TRANS_TYPE
		FROM PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
		LEFT JOIN PV_VIP_GRADE pvg ON pvg.COMPANY_CODE=pvbm.COMPANY_CODE and pvg.VIP_NO=pvbm.VIP_NO
		--where pvbm.VIP_NO in ('01000050343','01000050737') 
		UNION ALL
		SELECT DISTINCT pvbm.COMPANY_CODE, pvg.VIP_GRADE_CODE, pvbm.VIP_NO,CONVERT(DATE, pvb.BALANCE_DT) as MOVEMENT_DT,
			pvb.BALANCE as POINT_MOVEMENT, 'ISSUED' as TRANS_TYPE
		FROM PL_VIP_BP_MOVEMENT pvbm 
		LEFT JOIN PV_VIP_GRADE pvg ON pvg.COMPANY_CODE=pvbm.COMPANY_CODE and pvg.VIP_NO=pvbm.VIP_NO
		LEFT JOIN PM_VIP pv on pv.COMPANY_CODE =pvbm.COMPANY_CODE and pv.VIP_NO =pvbm.VIP_NO
		INNER JOIN PL_VIP_BP_BALANCE pvb on pv.COMPANY_CODE = pvb.COMPANY_CODE 
			and pv.VIP_ID = pvb.VIP_ID_FK and pvb.BALANCE_DT <= pvbm.MOVEMENT_DT
		--where pvbm.VIP_NO in ('01000050343','01000050737')
	) d
PIVOT (	SUM(POINT_MOVEMENT)
		for TRANS_TYPE in ([REDEEM], [EXPIRED], [ADJUSTMENT], [ISSUED])
	) piv 
group by COMPANY_CODE, VIP_GRADE_CODE, VIP_NO 
) pvj
